jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

The role drives complex technical projects from inception to delivery, aligning engineering, product, and design teams around shared milestones.

The project manager owns execution rhythms, unblocks technical dependencies, and ensures high-quality software ships on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

Drive end-to-end execution for core engineering initiatives, managing sprint planning, roadmaps, and release cycles using Jira and Linear
Identify technical risks, scope creep, and cross-team dependencies early, surfacing proactive mitigation strategies
Facilitate agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives
Track velocity, burn-down charts, and key delivery metrics to maintain team accountability and predictable cadence
Coordinate cross-functional communication between engineering, product management, and QA to ensure seamless feature deployments
Maintain centralized documentation for architecture decisions, project status, and product requirements using Confluence and Notion

What We Are Looking For

4-7 years of technical project or program management experience within a fast-paced software engineering environment
Deep familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies; PMP or Scrum Master certifications are a plus
Strong technical literacy, capable of engaging in architectural discussions with senior engineers and leads
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting status to technical and executive stakeholders
Proficiency with modern project tracking and collaboration software including Jira, Confluence, GitHub, and Slack
Bonus: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, along with hands-on experience scaling distributed microservices

jobs.description:
Overview

JOB DESCRIPTION

Verint's Senior Program Manager, Program Management Office (PMO) plays a central role in driving strategic initiatives across the product and engineering organization. This person works closely with the senior leadership to bring structure, transparency, and momentum to the programs that matter most. The role spans planning frameworks, cross-functional governance, tooling, and a bias toward getting things done over documenting process.

We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable in a leadership meeting setting direction and in the weeds resolving a dependency. The ideal candidate has deep experience running complex programs in SaaS environments, understands how modern product and engineering organizations work, and knows how to build alignment and move work forward fast across a distributed company.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities Strategic Program Leadership

Own strategic programs from initiation through delivery and adoption, maintaining clarity on goals, scope, and status at every stage.
Create visibility and alignment across leadership by translating complex program activity into clear, decision-ready reporting.
Track deadlines, deliverables, resources, and action items with rigor, and hold owners accountable for their commitments.
Identify cross-team dependencies and risks early, and make sure they are visible, owned, and mitigated before they become blockers.

Process and Governance

Design, refine, and roll out planning and governance processes that help a distributed product organization move faster and more consistently.
Define and track KPIs that give leadership a clear picture of engineering effectiveness, delivery health, and team capacity.
Identify opportunities to use AI-assisted workflows to reduce manual effort in status reporting, documentation, and data synthesis.
Facilitate retrospectives and lessons-learned sessions that actually result in changes, not just documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Product, Engineering, CloudOps, and Support & Services to streamline delivery and reduce friction at the hand-off points.
Support post-merger integration work by helping newly combined teams align on shared processes, tools, and ways of working.
Lead change efforts that connect directly to business outcomes - faster delivery, reduced rework, better predictability.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 4 years in a senior or lead capacity in a software or SaaS environment
Demonstrated track record running complex, cross-functional programs in a matrixed, global organization
Strong facilitation skills - able to run a room, navigate ambiguity, and move stakeholders toward decisions across different time zones and teams
Experience standing up or significantly improving PMO practices inside a product or engineering organization
Solid understanding of Agile and hybrid delivery methodologies; comfortable working alongside both scrum teams and portfolio-level planning
Experience with enterprise planning tools, particularly Aha! and Jira; familiarity with data-driven reporting and executive dashboards
Comfortable working alongside AI-assisted workflows and curious about where they can reduce friction in PMO operations
Successful completion of a background screening process including, but not limited to, employment verifications, criminal search, OFAC, SS Verification, as well as credit and drug screening, where applicable and in accordance with federal and local regulations

Preferred Qualifications

PMP or equivalent certification
Experience in CX, CCaaS, WFM, or enterprise SaaS
Exposure to M&A integration work or operating inside a PE-backed technology company
Hands-on experience with WSJF or other value-based prioritization frameworks

Verint has a zero-tolerance policy against any form of discrimination, retaliation, or harassment including sexual harassment or any other form of harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, genetic information, disability, veteran status, and any other classification or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. jobs.description:
HSO International – Project Manager

Position
: Project Manager

Department
: Program Services

Visa Sponsorship:
You must have legal working rights in your country of residence within the EMEA region. Sponsorship and relocation only available within the Netherlands

Type of work:
Remote or Hybrid, depending on location

International travel is required depending on program needs. Minimun 35% travelling

About The Role

The Project Manager at HSO is accountable for the successful delivery of a defined project or major workstream within a broader transformation program. This role owns delivery outcomes within clear boundaries: scope, schedule, quality, readiness, and customer adoption for their project.

In this role, your primary focus is on driving execution excellence. You spend most of your time on detailed planning, sequencing, dependency management, readiness control (testing, data, cutover), issue resolution, and day-to-day delivery leadership. You optimize outcomes within given constraints and ensure that delivery reality is visible early.

If you want a role where you own the execution layer of large or complex global programs and make a direct impact on delivery success, this is it.

Leading Microsoft Partner

HSO belongs to the elite Microsoft Dynamics Inner Circle for 21 years, within the top 1% of all Microsoft partners worldwide. With over 2,800 professionals and a worldwide presence, we deliver successful implementations across industries globally.

HSO International

At HSO International, you’ll join a diverse team of 300+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities, working on cross-border projects that make a global impact.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: https://www.hso.com/en/campaigns/life-at-hso-international/

Key Responsibilities

Own day-to-day delivery of assigned projects or complex program workstreams, ensuring scope, plan, dependencies, and customer readiness remain aligned
Participate in pre-sales and mobilization by shaping delivery plans, budgets, governance models, and risk assumptions that are executable in practice
Contribute to and co-author Statements of Work (SOW), with specific accountability for assumptions, risks, delivery economics, team structures, phase entry/exit criteria, and change control
Build and maintain integrated delivery plans that align architecture, build, testing, integrations, and customer activities
Coordinate cross-functional delivery across architects, developers, functional consultants, testers, integration teams, and customer SMEs
Monitor requirements gathering and setting acceptance criteria, ensure backlog items are sized, prioritized, and ready for build
Drive testing readiness, including test planning, data availability, environment coordination, defect management, and go-live preparation
Maintain strong RAID discipline, proactively identifying risks, issues, dependencies, and downstream impacts
Identify scope gaps early and initiate structured change-control discussions when required
Run governance forums that drive real decisions, including steering committees, risk reviews, and change control boards
Communicate clear, factual status and risk updates to customers, senior project managers, and program leadership
Partner with customers to strengthen their ability to participate effectively in requirements, testing, data readiness, and decision-making
Contribute to continuous improvement of HSO’s Standard Working Practices (SWP) and delivery quality culture
Depending on seniority and complexity of an assigned project, you will work under the guidance and direction of a Senior Project Manager or Program Manager.

Requirements

5+ year’s experience delivering ERP Microsoft Dynamics. Data, or digital transformation projects is preferable within ERP implementations.
Must exposure to Dynamics 365 ERP experience or comparable enterprise platforms
Experience in complex, multi-team or multi-stakeholder environments and international consultancy experience
Strong grounding in planning, backlog management, requirements clarification, testing preparation, and RAID (Risks, Actions, Issues, and Decisions)
Experience working within structured delivery frameworks and governance models
Ability to see and manage task-level delays and manage their downstream impacts
Ability to simplify complexity and drive clarity in pressured environments
Experience using DevOps or similar delivery management tools.
Hands-on, structured, and proactive approach to execution and problem solving.
Confidence to escalate issues factually and early
Influence without authority; create clarity and accountability through facts, options, and trade-offs
Structured approach to risk management, ambiguity, and scenario-based decision-making
Awareness of delivery economics and commercial impact
Ability to balance scope, quality, time, and cost without false certainty
International travel required depending on program needs. Minimun 35% travelling

Benefits

Why should you choose HSO International?

Development and growth

You get a job with plenty of career opportunities with a leading provider of innovative enterprise business solutions and a distinct Microsoft Global Solution Integrator, who perceives your motivations, talents, and ambitions.

Career Path for this role

HSO Offers a Clear, Capability-based Progression For Delivery Professionals

Project Coordinator / PMO → Project Manager → Senior Project Manager → Program Manager.

Project Managers grow by mastering execution discipline, customer leadership, and cross-team coordination within global transformation programs.

Fun and success

You work in a collaborative and professional environment where success is built on teamwork and with colleagues who are ready to help each other.

International project exposure

Joining our team offers an exciting opportunity to engage in international projects, providing invaluable exposure to diverse cultures, markets, and perspectives. Through your involvement in these projects, you will broaden your global network, enhance your cross-cultural communication skills, and gain firsthand experience in navigating the complexities of international collaboration.

Freedom and responsibility

You have the freedom and flexibility to organize your workdays, but especially to shape your own career.

Take the next step!

Does the combination of business processes and Microsoft technology appeal to you? Take the next step in your career path with HSO International!

Together, the work we do connects people and changes lives — including your own.

Be part of a dynamic, collaborative and caring organization committed to saving and improving lives. Thousands of patients depend on us every day for reliable access to safe blood, plasma, stem cells and organs and tissues.

About The Role

Canadian Blood Services is looking for a Temporary Full-Time Project Manager
to join our Network and Collections Transformation
team. The work of a Project Manager is integral to Canadian Blood Services role as Canada’s Lifeline.

In this role, you will be responsible for the planning, management, and implementation of projects within the Infrastructure Program. In close partnership with the Capital Planning and Development team you will coordinate, lead and manage the activities of the project team. Projects within the program aim to deliver new, operationally ready facilities with validated systems and equipment, and with the appropriate regulatory approvals and licenses in place. Projects also ensure that robust move and transition plans are in place and that operational teams are ready to transition to the new working environment.

Formula for Success

Leveraging your project management experience, you will lead the development of project plans for complex, multi-year projects, working within the organization’s defined project management standards and quality system requirements for projects.
Utilizing your collaboration, leadership and engagement skills, you will work with the project team in effectively accomplishing the goals and objectives of the project.
Drawing on your project leadership experience, you will monitor and document the overall project plan and budget, ensuring the project meets timelines, targets and expectations based on the established parameters, providing regular project status updates to all key partners on behalf of the project team.
Utilizing your communication, teamwork skills, and project experience, you will coordinate the activities of the project team, internal and external partners to develop the project plan, define deliverables, identify roles and responsibilities, establish timelines, training strategies, implementation and evaluation strategies, risk management, costs, transition, and close-out plans.
Drawing on your decision-making and problem-solving expertise, you will make recommendations for review with leadership regarding project deliverables, costs, and timelines, which will impact other business areas.
Using your risk management expertise, identify, monitor, and mitigate substantial risks, with implications beyond the project.
Using your change management experience, collaborate with colleagues to navigate sensitive or complex stakeholder communications, remove barriers, and facilitate change management.

Desired Education & Skills

Post-secondary level education, preferably a university degree in a related field.
A minimum of 5 years of related experience, including progressive project management experience and/or training preferred.
Certification in Project Management, such as the PRINCE2, Project Management Professional (PMP) is an asset.
Ability to analyze complex problems, interpret business needs, communicate in clear and concise language and develop integrated, creative solutions.
Highly developed team leadership and interpersonal skills are required. Proven ability to build and manage professional relationships.
Knowledge of risk management concepts.
Ability to deal with senior management and external stakeholders.

What We Offer You

Payment in lieu for benefits and vacation.
Annual performance award up to 8%.
Defined benefit pension plan.
Employee discounts, wellness program, professional resources.

What You Can Expect

This role will work in a hybrid environment with requirements to be onsite at Canadian Blood Services location at least 40% of the time/2 days of the week.
Frequent travel will be essential, as this role supports project implementations across multiple CBS locations.

If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply by providing your up-to-date resume. This could be your first step towards a meaningful and inspiring career. Come to work each day knowing that you save lives.

We acknowledge that the work of Canadian Blood Services spans many Territories and Treaty areas across the country, and we are grateful for the Traditional Knowledge Keepers and Elders who have guided us in this important work. We recognize the land and waters that have inspired our work and offer gratitude to those Indigenous peoples on whose territory we work, live and play.

Diversity and inclusion play a vital role in ensuring health equity for patients across Canada. We are committed to reflecting Canada’s population in our organization and fostering an environment where all employees can be their authentic selves, with equal opportunities to succeed and contribute.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Roads)
jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

A Little More About Your Role…

As a Project Manager in the SDF (Service Delivery Framework) Roads team you’ll be working alongside a host of talented people ranging from our early career professionals to established engineers and project managers working across the Roads business to improve the local and strategic networks, based in our London & South East region (located in either of our: Cambridge, London (Westferry Circus), Basingstoke, Guildford or Southampton offices).

What is SDF? The National Highways Scheme Delivery Framework (SDF) is a multi-billion-pound procurement strategy used to maintain, renew, and improve England’s Strategic Road Network (SRN). It enables regional, collaborative, and performance-based contracts for works such as pavement, civil engineering, and technology to enhance safety and efficiency.

Being part of this framework team, you will lead the delivery of moderately complex projects, accountable for scope, schedule, budget, and resource management, while ensuring quality and compliance with WSP’s procedures and client requirements.

The role will offer an interesting and varied workload –

You Will

Develop project scopes, manage schedules, control budgets, and coordinate multidisciplinary teams. 
Lead stakeholder engagement, managing expectations, and maintaining strong client relationships. 
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues, maintaining registers and mitigation plans. 
Oversee procurement activities and contract compliance, working within NEC or similar frameworks. 
Ensure deliverables meet agreed quality standards and that reporting requirements are fulfilled. 
Manage project documentation, tracking milestones, resources, and change control. 
Mentor and upskill more junior staff helping them develop professionally and progress towards professional qualifications.
Work collaboratively with clients and key stakeholders as necessary to deliver the schemes/projects.

What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

APM PMQ or equivalent qualification is not a prerequisite but will be greatly beneficial to the role. 

Proven experience managing projects with accountability for delivery of scope, schedule, budget, and resources. 

Understanding of NEC contracts or similar, with experience in contract administration and compliance. 

Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and communicate effectively with stakeholders. 

Competency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project) and a proactive approach to process improvement. 

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

Work-life balance

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
What this job involves:

We are seeking a Project Manager to serve as the central coordination point for complex, cross-functional initiatives supporting the Business Management Office's (BMO) operational readiness and change management functions. Reporting to the BMO Process Excellence Manager, you will work closely with the product owner and operational readiness and change management leaders to own integrated project plans across multiple workstreams, manage cross-functional dependencies and downstream impacts, drive accountability for deliverable owners, and maintain visibility through consolidated status reporting and RAAIDD management. While this role does not own technical delivery, it requires genuine comfort with technology, an interest in emerging tools including AI, and the ability to understand the platforms and systems being implemented well enough to anticipate risks and manage dependencies effectively. The role requires strong facilitation skills, proactive risk identification, and the confidence to hold teams accountable. The ideal candidate is agile and flexible, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and brings a learning mindset—someone who takes detailed notes, asks the right questions, and builds deep understanding of the projects they support. You'll ensure the successful coordination and delivery of programs by maintaining alignment across workstreams, supporting stakeholder communications, coordinating UAT activities, surfacing gaps and risks early, and providing senior leadership with clear, actionable reporting. This role offers significant exposure to cross-functional program delivery and serves as a strong foundation for a career in strategic program management and business operations.

What your day-to-day will look like:

Own and maintain the integrated, non-technical project plan encompassing all workstreams, milestones, and deliverables while developing and managing the master project timeline to ensure alignment between operational readiness, change management, and product & engineering launch support activities
Track progress against milestones and proactively flag deviations, risks, or resource constraints while facilitating release planning sessions that ensure alignment on timelines, scope, and dependencies across all workstreams
Manage critical path activities and ensure sequencing of dependent deliverables (e.g., product & engineering feature completion → SOPs → training delivery) while coordinating go/no-go decision preparation with compiled readiness data from all workstreams
Serve as the single coordination point across product & engineering, operational readiness, and change management workstreams by maintaining dependency tracking and facilitating resolution across workstreams
Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts and resource constraints proactively while maintaining a decision log with follow-up tracking and facilitating cross-workstream alignment sessions with clear outcomes on timeline, scope, and dependency resolution
Conduct gap reviews with workstream leads to systematically identify what's missing, at risk, or blocked, and maintain centralized tracking showing owners, status, dependencies, timelines, and blockers for all deliverables
Develop mitigation plans when gaps are identified and drive them to resolution while proactively identifying emerging gaps before they become critical path issues
Provide bi-weekly consolidated status reports to senior leadership showing deliverable health, cross-workstream gaps, and needed escalations while developing and maintaining dashboard/reporting infrastructure providing real-time visibility into progress against milestones
Coordinate operational readiness activities including data collection (service matrices, system metadata, workflow documentation), track internal service delivery training material development and coordinate delivery, coordinate SOP strategy and delivery aligned to releases, manage FAQ development and content approval processes, and schedule and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across customers, service delivery partners, and internal teams
Support product & engineering launch activities by coordinating launch UAT testing logistics across all releases, facilitating defect triage coordination and severity assessment processes, coordinating launch day activities and issue escalation management, and tracking production environment cutover planning and execution
Maintain and actively manage the RAAIDD log (Risks, Assumptions, Actions, Issues, Dependencies, and Decisions) across all workstreams and releases, facilitate regular RAAIDD reviews with workstream leads to ensure timely identification, escalation, and resolution, and track dependency chains to proactively surface blockers
Support change management activities by tracking communication and engagement strategy delivery coordination, managing feedback collection mechanisms, coordinating participant engagement and readiness assessments, and supporting change impact analysis documentation and distribution.

Required Qualifications:

Demonstrated experience in project/program management for complex, cross-functional initiatives with proven success in coordinating multiple stakeholders
Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams with interdependent deliverables and competing timelines in dynamic environments
Experience with phased launch/rollout programs, ideally supporting technology platform implementations or enterprise system deployments
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without direct authority and build credibility across diverse teams
Excellent facilitation skills for cross-functional alignment sessions and decision-making forums with ability to drive meetings to actionable outcomes
Experience developing and maintaining integrated project plans, dependency maps, and critical path analyses with strong attention to detail
Proficiency in proactive risk identification, gap analysis, and mitigation planning with demonstrated ability to surface issues early
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level status reporting with ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable summaries
Demonstrated comfort with technology platforms, data dashboards, and emerging tools (e.g., AI-assisted workflows) with ability to quickly learn new systems and business contexts
Track record of driving accountability across teams and deliverable owners without direct authority through relationship-building and consistent follow-through.

Preferred Qualifications:

Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification demonstrating formal project management training and methodology expertise
Experience supporting technology platform launches within large-scale enterprise environments with multiple concurrent workstreams
Familiarity with change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci, ADKAR) and operational readiness frameworks
Experience coordinating across technical and non-technical teams where product & engineering operates independently (e.g., Agile/Scrum environments)
Background in event management or travel and meetings programs providing relevant business domain context
Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Asana, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar platforms
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain dashboards and reporting infrastructure that provides executive-level visibility.

Overview

This role requires to work with the UK Defense and Intelligence.

The successful candidate must have or be able to obtain the Security Check (SC) clearance as issued by the United Kingdom Security Vetting Unit (UKSV). Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role.

In the Microsoft Frontier Company Engineering team, you won’t just build software; you’ll deliver real outcomes for some of the world’s most complex organizations.

We are a global team of world-class engineers who have been working in a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model for more than a decade, embedding directly within customer teams to solve their toughest challenges, side-by-side, and shipping production-ready solutions in days, not months.

As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will embed with strategic customers to lead complex technical programs, owning the full customer journey from problem definition through delivery and driving measurable business outcomes. You’ll work in small, multidisciplinary crews alongside engineers, data scientists, and designers, operating with high autonomy to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions.

Our work is powered by AI, applying the mindset and tooling across the entire development lifecycle to move from idea to production in days while maintaining the highest standards of security, quality, and trust.

This Role Offers The Opportunity To

Lead complex technical programs from problem definition through to delivered outcomes
Drive decisions that directly influence business strategy and customer outcomes
Collaborate with leading global organizations across industries
Apply the latest advancements in AI and engineering workflows to deliver value at scale

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Embed with strategic customers to lead complex technical programs with high autonomy, aligning business needs with engineering solutions across AI, cloud, and data. Take ownership of the customer journey end-to-end, from problem definition through co-engineering delivery to measurable business outcomes.

Embodies our culture and values.

Bachelor’s Degree AND experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

Experience partnering directly with customers or internal stakeholders to deliver solutions end-to-end.

Experience in customer-facing technical roles (e.g., consulting, solutions engineering, field engineering, or similar).

jobs.title: Enhanced Care Management Program Manager
jobs.description:
ECM Program Manager

Pacific Health Group | Transforming Care Through Connection

At Pacific Health Group, we're more than just a healthcare organization—we're driving real change. As an ECM Program Manager, you'll lead our Enhanced Care Management program, making sure vulnerable populations get the care, support, and advocacy they need to live healthier, more stable lives. You'll guide regional teams to deliver compassionate, person-centered care that improves outcomes and supports our mission to close health equity gaps across California.

Role Overview

This position is all about leadership, program oversight, and innovation. You'll supervise Lead Care Managers, across the hiring county, ensuring the team has the support and resources needed to succeed. You'll oversee program quality, member services, cross-functional partnerships, budgeting, and program growth initiatives. Your work will directly impact the lives of high-need populations while strengthening Pacific Health Group's reputation for excellence in care.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Supervision

Mentor and guide Lead Care Managers across multiple counties.
Conduct weekly one-on-ones to address challenges, review caseloads, and provide coaching.
Lead weekly team meetings to share updates, review cases, and encourage collaboration.
Meet in-person with staff regularly to maintain strong leadership presence.

Program Development & Quality Assurance

Establish benchmarks and metrics to track program performance.
Implement quality assurance protocols and standardized workflows.
Monitor staff performance and use data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.

Member Services Oversight

Ensure members are receiving in-person visits and high-quality care.
Monitor documentation and provide support for challenging cases.
Implement strategies to improve member engagement and satisfaction.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Serve as liaison between ECM program and hospitals, providers, and community organizations.
Collaborate with data and compliance teams to track outcomes and maintain regulatory standards.
Strengthen partnerships to improve care transitions and reduce hospital readmissions.

Budget & Resource Management

Develop and manage program budgets, allocate resources efficiently, and track expenditures.
Adjust staffing and resources based on member needs and program priorities.

Program Innovation & Growth

Identify opportunities to enhance program effectiveness.
Pilot new initiatives such as telehealth to expand access to care.
Stay current on best practices and integrate improvements.

Additional Examples

Lead operational huddles and bi-weekly case conferences.
Develop mentorship programs and regional trainings for staff.
Prepare quarterly performance reports and maintain stakeholder relationships.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Nursing, or related field.
5+ years in healthcare management, including 3+ years in care/case management.
2+ years managing Enhanced Care Management or intensive care management programs.

Knowledge & Skills

Understanding of care management principles and healthcare delivery systems.
Experience with Medicaid/Medicare programs and ECM program requirements.
Strong analytical skills and experience in data-driven program evaluation.

Personal Attributes

Strong leadership and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Commitment to person-centered care and health equity.

Working Conditions

Regular travel (65%) to county sites in California.
Occasional evening or weekend availability for program initiatives

Compensation

Pay: $80,000 - $85,000 annual salary

Requirements

Must reside within hiring county
Valid California Driver's License and active auto insurance meeting CA requirements
﻿Reliable personal vehicle for daily work use
﻿﻿Successful completion of background check (including MVR)
﻿﻿Must be able to travel up to 60-70% within the county to conduct in person visits
﻿﻿Must successfully complete a Testlify skills assessment
﻿﻿Must have a reliable working laptop for the first 21 days of employment (personal equipment stipend) until company issued laptop is received
﻿﻿Must have effective Time Management skills
﻿﻿Must have internet speed of - 300+ mbps download and 25+mbps upload
﻿﻿Must be proficient in technology, including documentation systems, case management platforms, and communication tools
Must be willing to work occasional evenings and weekends as needed

Benefits & Perks

160 Hours of Paid Time Off (PTO)
12 Paid Holidays per year, including your birthday and one floating holiday granted after 1 year of employment
4 Paid Volunteer Hours per Month to support causes you care about
Bereavement Leave, including Fur Baby Bereavement
90% Employer-paid Employee-Only Medical Benefits
FSA | Dependent Care Account
401(k) with Company Match
Monthly Stipend
Short-Term & Long-Term Disability | AD&D
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Employee Discounts via Great Work Perks and Perks at Work
Quarterly In-Person Events
Fully remote work within California
Opportunities for professional development and internal growth

jobs.title: Enterprise Security Manager
jobs.description:
Enterprise Security Manager

Job Title:
Enterprise Security Manager
Employment Type:
Full-time; Embedded Employee, Remote (U.S.-based), with domestic and international travel required
Reports To:
Director of Enterprise Security, Security Manager, or Head of Executive Protection

Job Overview

In collaboration with Johnson Controls, we are seeking an experienced Enterprise Security Manager to lead security program development and coordination of executive and personnel security across the organization. This remote role manages risk and vulnerability assessment processes; coordinates advance planning and secure logistics for executive travel and events; and serves as the primary liaison to contracted executive protection professionals when dedicated protective coverage is required. The ideal candidate combines strong security program management experience with sound judgment, discretion, and the relationship-building skills needed to work directly with executive leadership and cross-functional partners.

Key Responsibilities

Security Operations

Coordinate security activities with internal security teams, business leaders, and external partners.
Track domestic and international security developments affecting executive and employee safety, and share relevant updates with leadership and stakeholders.
Support crisis management, emergency response, and business continuity initiatives.
Develop and maintain enterprise security policies, procedures, and standards.
Ensure compliance with corporate security policies and legal requirements.
Oversee contracted executive protection personnel when required.
Coordinate security risk vulnerability assessments of JCI facilities and identified third-party facilities, working with contracted assessment partners as needed.
Communicate relevant security-related updates to the team, executives, and other appropriate stakeholders regarding risks to JCI personnel, facilities, and associated assets.

2. Executive & Personnel Security Program Management

Manage risk and vulnerability assessment processes for executives, inclusive of residences, venues, facilities, and related events, working with contracted partners as needed. Develop and recommend mitigation strategies based on identified risks.
Coordinate advance planning and site assessment processes for executive travel, meetings, conferences, and special events, and develop corresponding security plans in partnership with contracted assessment providers.
Coordinate secure transportation, accommodations, and logistics for executives and designated personnel.
Accompany executives on domestic and international travel to provide on-site logistical coordination, situational awareness, and continuity of security planning; serve as the primary liaison to contracted executive protection professionals when dedicated protective coverage is required.
oordinate with contracted vendors on monitoring public information sources for content that may pose a risk to executives or the firm's reputation, and route findings for appropriate follow-up.

3. Travel Security

Coordinate travel risk assessments for domestic and international trips for identified senior personnel and other JCI employees traveling to high-risk locales, working with contracted assessment partners as needed.
Develop executive travel security plans and contingency measures.
As required, coordinate with medical, transportation, and security providers for JCI travelers globally.
Track relevant threat information and provide security updates before and during travel.

4. Relationship Management

Build strong relationships with executive leadership and support staff.
Liaise with law enforcement, government agencies, and security partners.
Provide security awareness guidance and protective briefings to executives and their teams.
Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive business and personal information.

Required Qualifications

1. Education

Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Security Management, Intelligence Studies, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

2. Licensing & Certifications

Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.

3. Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of executive protection, corporate security, law enforcement, or military experience.
Experience with security planning and managing corporate security programs.
Demonstrated knowledge of executive protection principles and industry best practices.
Ability to travel frequently, including international travel.

4. Physical Requirements

Ability to stand, walk, and remain alert for extended periods.
Ability to respond rapidly during emergencies.
Ability to lift and carry security-related equipment as needed.
Capability to travel on short notice and work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

5. Key Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Certified Protection Professional (CPP).
Executive Protection certifications from recognized organizations.
Experience supporting C-suite executives and board members within a large enterprise environment.
Knowledge of global security risk trends and crisis management.
Medical response, first aid, CPR, AED, or tactical emergency casualty care certifications.

Core Competencies

Executive Security Program Management
Risk Assessment Coordination
Crisis Management
Travel Security
Security Operations Coordination
 Incident Response
Communication and Briefing Skills
Relationship Management
Confidentiality and Professionalism
Strategic Planning

Working Conditions

This role operates across corporate offices, executive residences, airports, hotels, and public venues, with domestic and international travel required. The Enterprise Security Manager should be prepared to operate in dynamic environments, adapt to changing schedules, and work flexible hours — including evenings, weekends, and holidays — while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and discretion.

Compensation

$100k - $115k based on experience
Excellent Benefits incl: Medical, Dental, Vision, AD&D, Life insurance
Matched 401k Plan
PTO - in accordance with company policy
12 Paid Holidays

Other

Hours: M-F 8-5: Some after-hours or weekend work is possible due to security-related work or attending travel requirements.
30-50% Travel - 2-5 days per week.
Business casual and/or professional dress during travel.

jobs.description:
Job Title :
Technical Program Manager
Location:
Vancouver, BC (Hybrid)
Job Type:
Full Time Role

Job description:

Role Summary:

We are seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager (TPM)
to lead complex, cross-portfolio technology initiatives within Global Product Technology, with a strong focus on Merch Planning, Forecasting, Sizing, and Allocation systems
.
This role operates at the intersection of business and technology
, owning delivery across multiple interdependent programs. The Staff TPM is responsible for driving end-to-end outcomes, shaping technical and business decisions, and ensuring planning and allocation capabilities deliver measurable business impact
.
This role requires deep understanding of retail planning lifecycles, inventory flow, and allocation strategies
, combined with the ability to orchestrate complex technology delivery at scale
.

Key Responsibilities

1. Portfolio Ownership & Program Leadership

Own end-to-end delivery outcomes across multiple programs
spanning Merch Planning, Sizing, Forecasting, Allocation, and Inventory Optimization
Drive alignment across Flowstate initiatives that support:
Forecast-driven size curves
In-season reforecasting
Allocation and transfer optimization
Ensure execution aligns to GTM gates, buy cycles, and merchandising decision timelines

2. Merch Planning & Allocation Business Acumen (Critical)

Serve as a thought partner to Merch Planning and Allocation leaders
, translating business needs into scalable technology solutions
Deeply understand and incorporate:
Pre-season planning (assortment planning, size curves, buy quantities)
In-season management (reforecasting, transfers, sell-through optimization)
Allocation strategies across DCs and stores
Evaluate tradeoffs between:
Forecast accuracy vs responsiveness
Inventory optimization vs service levels
Automation vs planner control
Ensure technology solutions directly improve:
Forecast accuracy
Inventory productivity
Allocation efficiency
Time-to-decision for planners

3. Technical & Strategic Decision Leadership

Drive cross-system decision-making
(architecture, sequencing, data flows, integration with planning tools like Anaplan, Snowflake, etc.)
Lead decision frameworks (options, tradeoffs, recommendations)
for business and technology leadership
Ensure solutions reflect end-to-end planning workflows
, not isolated system improvements
Act as a technical and business translator
between Planning, Product, and Engineering

4. Release Governance & Delivery Management

Own and evolve release governance and readiness processes
across planning and allocation systems
Ensure releases align to critical business windows (GTM, buys, peak seasons)

Drive proactive coordination of:
Data dependencies (forecast inputs, inventory signals)
Cross-system releases impacting planners
Prevent business disruption through tight release discipline and validation rigor

5. Delivery Excellence & Operating Model Design

Design and scale delivery operating models for planning systems
across multiple teams
Standardize execution practices across:
Backlog readiness tied to business outcomes
Planning feature prioritization
Cross-team coordination
Lead initiatives to improve:
Delivery predictability
Feature adoption by business users
Quality of outputs used by planners

6. Cross-Functional Orchestration & Dependency Management

Act as the single-threaded owner connecting Merch Planning, Allocation, Engineering, Data, and Product teams

Manage dependencies across:
Forecasting engines
Sizing logic
Allocation and transfer systems
Surface and resolve risks tied to data quality, model outputs, and downstream planning impacts

7. Operational Excellence & Incident Leadership

Lead response to production issues impacting planning or allocation outcomes
(forecast errors, allocation mismatches, data delays)
Drive root cause analysis with both technical and business context

Ensure continuous improvements in:
SLA adherence
Data accuracy and reliability
Planning system stability

8. Executive Influence & Stakeholder Leadership

Deliver executive-ready insights linking technology delivery to business outcomes
(inventory, forecast accuracy, allocation effectiveness)
Influence prioritization decisions based on business value, not just delivery feasibility

Partner with senior leaders across:
Merch Planning
Allocation
Product
Engineering

9. Scalable Mechanisms & Organizational Impact

Build scalable mechanisms tailored to planning and allocation domains:
Forecast validation frameworks
Allocation readiness checklists
Dependency maps across data → models → planning tools
Enable teams to operate with clarity, accountability, and business alignment

Coach PMs/TPMs on connecting delivery execution to merchandising outcomes

Required Qualifications

8–12+ years in Technical Program Management or Program Management

Proven experience owning portfolio-level programs across planning, supply chain, or retail technology domains

Strong understanding of:
Merch Planning and Allocation processes
Forecasting and inventory optimization concepts
Cross-functional delivery in data-driven systems
Demonstrated ability to influence both technical and business leadership decisions

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Anaplan, planning systems, or allocation engines

Exposure to AI/ML-based forecasting or optimization models

Experience with data platforms (e.g., Snowflake) and end-to-end data pipelines

Background in retail, apparel, or omnichannel inventory environments

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s of engineering, or related fields.

GE Vernova is accelerating the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy, while helping our customers power economies and deliver the electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life. jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, FDE Engagements
jobs.description:
This role oversees the lifecycle of forward-deployed engineering engagements in which MongoDB Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) partner closely with customer engineering teams to build working agents.

It is a high-impact role at the intersection of customer delivery, AI agent development, and product feedback. By working closely with customers during implementation, the Sr. Technical Program Manager helps shape real-world agent outcomes, demonstrate the value of MongoDB’s platform in live enterprise environments, and bring back insights that can inform future product direction.

These engagements are designed to help customers realize business value from our platform, accelerate successful agent delivery, and generate product feedback through close collaboration during implementation.

The Sr. Technical Program Manager, FDE Engagements drives successful delivery by aligning stakeholders, managing risks and dependencies, removing operational blockers, and ensuring clear ownership, communication, and decision-making across the engagement lifecycle. In partnership with FDE, Product, Engineering, account teams, and customer stakeholders, this role is accountable for program execution and engagement outcomes.

If an action item does not yet have an explicitly assigned owner, the Sr. Technical Program Manager is responsible for driving assignment and follow-through until ownership is clear.

Pre-customer environment access

Main goals:

Secure access to the customer's internal collaboration and development tooling as early as possible
Align on the intended behavior, functionality, and architecture of the agents
Define how the FDE team and customer engineering team will collaborate on use case and architecture definition, code, and execution
Establish the deployment path for MongoDB’s tools across customer development and cloud environments
Confirm business goals, technical scope, and success criteria for the engagement

During this phase, the Sr. Technical Program Manager partners with the assigned FDE team, account teams, and customer stakeholders to coordinate onboarding requirements, dependency management, planning, and readiness activities. This may include coordinating statements of work, contractor onboarding steps, access approvals, and early execution planning.

The pre-access period should also be used to build a shared understanding of the business value, intended behavior, and technical architecture of the agent. The team should prepare the technical design inputs needed to break the work into executable tasks in the customer's preferred engineering collaboration environment.

Deliverables:

Engagement overview deck
Agent technical spec
Agent architecture
Mutually agreed-upon definition of success

Agent build and prototyping

Main goals

Enable the joint engineering team to develop agents locally and contribute to a shared code repository
Establish a viable path to deployment in MongoDB’s production environment
Support a single-team execution model across MongoDB and customer engineers
Provide structured status updates and feedback loops to internal product stakeholders

During this phase, the team should adapt to the customer’s preferred engineering collaboration model where it supports execution. FDEs may lead or contribute to technical workstreams, while the Sr. Technical Program Manager drives coordination, planning, risk management, communication, escalation and execution tracking across the engagement.

FDEs kick off this phase by running an onboarding session for the customer engineering team to ensure that local development setup is seamless. FDEs should then act as a leader or member of their engineering team to break out the work in the agents’ technical spec into tickets that are picked up by both the FDE and customer’s engineers.

One particular item to look out for are red tape and restrictions around cloud deployments. Since our customers are often regulated industries, we might need to work with VDIs and artifact repositories instead of our native Github tooling. It should be a priority to determine the path to deploying the agents once code complete.

Deliverables

Customer onboarding session
Engagement status updates and feedback to the Product team about issues or unmet needs
Working agent deployed onto the product, integrated into the customer’s cloud infrastructure

Readout and closeout of engagement

Main goals

Confirm long-term ownership of the agent
Ensure the customer has a roadmap for continued usage and development
Identify opportunities for future paid FDE engagement support where appropriate

Once the agent fulfills the initial engagement requirements, the team should prepare an engagement readout that demonstrates what was built, what business value was created, and what path exists for continued investment and adoption.

By the end of this phase, the customer should be positioned to continue development of the agent independently and to provide ongoing product feedback to MongoDB. Where appropriate, MongoDB may continue to support the customer through additional phases of the project.

Deliverables

Engagement readout deck
MongoDB-internal perspective on future FDE engagement opportunities

Qualifications

5+ years of experience leading complex technical programs or engineering initiatives from initiation through delivery, including planning, execution, and cross-functional coordination in customer-facing enterprise software, platform, infrastructure, or applied AI environments.
Working fluency in modern AI application architectures, including LLM-based workflows, retrieval and grounding patterns, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation approaches, with the ability to partner credibly with technical teams and scope technical tradeoffs
Demonstrated success operating in ambiguous, fast-changing technical environments and driving programs forward through structured planning, proactive dependency management, and clear decision-making
Strong ability to partner across Engineering, Product, customer stakeholders, and delivery teams to align goals, scope, priorities, timelines, and execution across the full engagement lifecycle, from onboarding and access planning through technical design, deployment, executive readouts, and transition to long-term ownership
Fluency in English, spoken and written
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear documentation, maintain durable decision records, tailor communication to technical, executive, and customer audiences, and connect technical delivery decisions to customer business value, adoption, and long-term growth opportunities

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in forward-deployed, embedded, or other high-touch customer delivery models
Experience working with regulated or operationally constrained customer environments, including enterprise access controls, non-standard development tooling, artifact repositories, and deployment governance

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

Additional duties include reviewing technical deliverables, validating invoices, maintaining fiscal‑year performance dashboards, conducting spend‑plan tracking, and managing project data within enterprise systems such as the Strategic Management Tool (SMT). Senior Project Manager 

Discover Veranova:

At Veranova, we believe people are our most important asset, and we are dedicated to building the most talented workforce in our industry. Our commitment to uncompromising focus on quality, compliance, safety, and excellence in delivery shapes everything we do. We are not just looking for skills; we are seeking innovative individuals who have a mindset open to learning and growth, and a desire to make a difference. Every role at Veranova plays a part in delivering an exceptional customer experience through ownership and integrity.

Veranova is a global leader in the development and manufacturing of complex active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for pharma and biotech customers. With deep technical expertise and impressive flexibility, we develop solutions and processes that support and accelerate innovation. 

Join us on our mission to enable current and next-generation therapeutics to improve and save the lives of patients. 

Role Overview: 

The Senior Project Manager will lead cross-functional project teams to deliver complex CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization) programs. This role is responsible for managing R&D and manufacturing activities, including seamless technology transfers between internal and client manufacturing sites. Serving as the primary point of contact for the client, the Senior Project Manager ensures alignment across all internal and external stakeholders. The PM is responsible for ensuring the client contracts are being managed and will use their organizational, collaboration, influencing and leadership skills to initiate, plan, execute and monitor client projects.

This position requires close collaboration with cross-functional areas including development, manufacturing, supply chain, quality and finance to drive execution and program deliverables. This role demands a high level of technical acumen, strong communication skills, and the ability to coordinate across multiple functions and sites. The Senior Project Manager is accountable for ensuring that program objectives are met on time, within scope and budget, and in accordance with quality and regulatory standards. 

Core Responsibilities:

Provide strategic oversight of end-to-end drug substance program lifecycle, ensuring successful progression through development, scale-up, validation, and commercial readiness; Own program financial performance, including scope governance, and timely execution of change orders and client billing. 

Lead, motivate and hold accountable high-performing cross-functional project teams, establishing clear ownership, driving effective decision making, and fostering a culture of excellence and customer-focused delivery.

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring alignment on project goals, timelines, deliverables, and expectations. 

Develop and manage integrated project plans, including scope, timelines, resources, risk mitigation strategies, and budgets; Champion proactive risk and issue management, driving cross-functional mitigation strategies, leading executive-level escalations, and ensuring rapid resolution of program barriers. 

Lead governance forums, client meetings, and executive updates with clear communication of program status, risks, decisions and strategic recommendations.

Lead complex technology transfers across internal and client manufacturing sites, ensuring technical readiness, risk mitigation, and flawless execution.

Qualifications: 

Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.

Minimum of 6-8 years of project management experience in the pharmaceutical CDMO industry, with a strong focus on drug substance development and manufacturing. 

Demonstrates fundamentals and concepts of managerial accounting and P&L management.

Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and interface with executive leadership to drive client and organizational alignment.

Strong understanding of cGMP ICH and regulatory guidance impacting drug substance development and manufacturing.

Demonstrated ability to build trust, manage expectations, and represent the organization with professionalism and credibility; Comfortable influencing without authority and driving collaboration across departments and levels; Demonstrated ability to influence senior-level stakeholders and navigate complex client dynamics.

Ability to motivate and lead cross-functional teams to high performance and ownership; Track record of delivering high-touch service, acting with urgency and accountability in all client interactions.

Understands the CDMO program management process, including the management of client contracts, management of change orders, revenue leakages, invoicing and passthrough concepts between others to ensure we keep a wholistic approach when managing programs and their revenue value.

jobs.title: Deputy Program Manager - SOCOM
jobs.description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Job Overview

About Our Team

Programs partners closely with Growth, Engineering, Production, Procurement, Software, and Product teams to define scope, align resources, and manage cost, schedule, and risk. It's our collective, team-driven approach that powers execution to meet and exceed the expectations of our growing customer base. In an environment where things move fast and operate in open-ended, ambiguous problem spaces, we trust and empower each team member to operate independently and take full ownership of their work. When faced with roadblocks, each team member is expected to think critically and bring potential solutions to the table. When it comes to communication, the default is transparency; sharing context, decisions, and progress freely. Lastly, feedback flows in every direction; we experiment, question, and learn together by speaking directly and honestly.

About The Role

This is a hands-on role for someone who owns the details and gets the work done, and it is an ideal next step for a candidate ready to grow into a Program Manager. The position will be largely in-person, because close, face-to-face collaboration is how our SOCOM customers work best. A working understanding of maritime and/or autonomous systems (schematics, software, CAD, wiring diagrams, and system-level architecture) is highly beneficial for bridging communications and understanding of various lines of effort across technical, operational, and administrative teams. The DPM may support one or more lines of effort across multiple SOCOM-focused contracts at once.

Responsibilities

Scoping & Scheduling

Partner with Growth to translate SOCOM opportunities and customer demand into clear, defensible scope and schedules.
Support proposal inputs, including scope, statements of work, and basis of estimate, ensuring what we propose is technically grounded, executable, and aligned to strategic, engineering, and timeline realities.
Build and maintain work breakdown structures and execution schedules that connect growth commitments to engineering and production reality.

Program Execution

Support the Program Manager across all five process groups (initiation, planning, execution, monitoring & control, and closeout) on one or more concurrent programs.
Track schedules, requirements, budgets, deliverables, and integration milestones, including Government- and Contractor-Furnished Equipment (GFE/CFE).
Coordinate design, build, on-water testing, and readiness activities to meet contract milestones, and de-risk critical path items.
Maintain configuration and documentation compliance across all program phases.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Serve as a day-to-day point of contact across Engineering, Production, Quality, and Training, communicating objectives, milestones, and changes so everyone knows what they own and when.
Lead recurring coordination meetings to keep execution aligned to the delivery schedule.
Engage confidently in technical discussions and interpret engineering documentation (BOMs, CAD, wire diagrams) to resolve issues and keep teams aligned.
Relay feedback from field operations, testing, and customer reviews back to internal teams for continuous improvement.

Risk, Compliance & Field Support

Identify, track, and help mitigate program risks and issues, maintaining risk registers and after-action reports across assigned programs.
Work with Contracts and Legal to keep scope, terms, and deliverables (CDRLs) accurately captured and compliant with contractual, DoD, ABS, and DCMA standards.
Support field operations, demos, and test events (readiness, integration, documentation, and after-action reviews), plus sustainment and logistics planning that keeps fielded systems mission-ready for operators downrange.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Naval Architecture, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
5+ years in program management, preferably in a defense, engineering, or technical environment, including support to SOF or SOCOM programs.
Familiarity with DoD program requirements, government contracting, and recognized program management standards.
Working knowledge of maritime and/or autonomous systems, with the ability to read technical documentation and engage credibly with engineers.
3+ years working across software-based toolsets, including MS Project, the MS Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), Confluence, and communicating with cross functional teams via Slack and other applications.
A bias for action and ownership in a fast-paced, high-trust, rapidly growing environment.
Willingness to travel up to 35% of the time.
Secret security clearance eligibility required, active preferred.

Preferred Qualification

PMP certification or demonstrated command of project management first principles and the five process groups.
Program management experience in shipbuilding, naval systems, unmanned systems, undersea systems, robotics, or other autonomous hardware prototyping or production focused efforts.
Direct SOF/SOCOM experience, with familiarity with SOF-peculiar requirements, mission planning, and sustainment/logistics systems.
Experience across multiple acquisition pathways, including FAR-based contracts, OTAs, and rapid prototyping authorities.
Direct service-branch background in program management, acquisitions, or SOF operations.
Advanced degree, or foreign language proficiency (e.g., Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, or Arabic).

Physical Demands

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Occasional standing and walking within the office
Manual dexterity to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment
Visual acuity to read screens, documents, and reports
Occasional reaching, bending, or stooping to access file drawers, cabinets, or office supplies
Lifting and carrying items up to 20 pounds occasionally (e.g., office supplies, packages)

Comprehensive health insurance plans covering a range of services

Saronic pays 100% of the premium for employees and 80% for dependents

Coverage for routine dental check-ups, orthodontics, and vision care

Saronic pays 100% of the premium under the basic plan for employees and 80% for dependents

Paid maternity and paternity leave to support new parents

Industry-standard salaries with opportunities for performance-based bonuses

401(k) plan with company match

Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

Basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage

Discounted pet insurance options including 24/7 Telehealth helpline

Free lunch benefit and unlimited free drinks and snacks in the office

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager – Digital Products
jobs.description:
The Technical Program Manager serves as the coordinating force across commercial and consumer-facing technology programs spanning the Restaurant Technology and Digital product teams. Embedded within the Restaurant Technology team and reporting to the VP of Restaurant Technology, this role ensures initiatives—including point-of-sale, digital ordering, customer relationship management, loyalty management, kiosks, promotions, delivery channel integrations, and consumer-facing applications—are delivered in a coordinated, sequenced, and business-aligned manner. This role facilitates cross-team planning, manages program interdependencies and risks, maintains enterprise-wide visibility into commercial technology delivery, and supports technical decision-making across internal engineering and vendor technical teams by surfacing trade-offs and driving alignment on integration approaches and dependencies. This high-visibility role sits at the intersection of technology execution and guest-facing business impact and requires organizational rigor and sufficient technical fluency to keep cross-team technical conversations productive.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Cross-Team Planning & Coordination
Maintain a unified program calendar across all Restaurant Technology and Digital product workstreams, surfacing timeline conflicts, resource overlaps, and sequencing risks.
Facilitate recurring cross-team planning sessions with product managers and program managers to align on priorities and dependencies.
Facilitate technical alignment discussions between internal engineering and vendor technical leads when integration approaches, architecture choices, or system dependencies require resolution; surface trade-offs and drive the group toward a decision or clear escalation path.
Translate executive priorities from the VP of Restaurant Technology into coordinated action plans distributed across the appropriate product and program owners.

Vendor & Partner Program Coordination
Coordinate scheduling and preparation for vendor roadmap sessions, sprint reviews, and performance reviews, ensuring the right internal stakeholders are engaged.
Track vendor delivery commitments across all active programs and flag deviations or risks to the appropriate product manager or program manager.
Maintain a consolidated vendor activity log across Restaurant Technology and Digital, giving the VP of Restaurant Technology a single view of third-party status.
Support RFP/RFI processes by coordinating internal inputs, managing review timelines, and ensuring cross-team participation in vendor evaluations.
Monitor and communicate upcoming vendor release windows, ensuring all impacted teams—including Digital, Operations, and Field Enablement—are informed and prepared.

Stakeholder & Digital Team Alignment
Serve as the primary coordination point between the Restaurant Technology team and the broader organization, including Digital Product, the CDO organization, PMO, Business Analysts, and other stakeholders, by facilitating joint planning sessions and managing cross-team dependencies.
Act as the liaison between technology teams and Field Enablement, ensuring training plans, rollout communications, and readiness checklists are developed and tracked for all releases.
Engage cybersecurity, compliance, and legal stakeholders proactively to ensure all programs maintain appropriate review timelines and approval gates.

Program & Release Coordination
Own the enterprise technology release calendar, coordinating go/no-go readiness across all active programs and ensuring releases are properly sequenced to minimize operational disruption at the restaurant level.
Facilitate UAT planning and pilot coordination across workstreams, tracking readiness milestones and communicating status to all stakeholders.
Produce and distribute release communications to field operations, franchise partners, and internal teams for all technology deployments.
Track post-release issues across programs and coordinate resolution efforts between the relevant product manager, vendor, and support teams.

Visibility, Reporting & Escalation
Produce weekly and monthly program status reports for the VP of Restaurant Technology, summarizing progress, risks, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all active workstreams.
Maintain a consolidated risk and issues log across all Restaurant Technology and Digital programs, tracking escalation status and resolution timelines.
Contribute program coordination and delivery data to operations intelligence products to support leadership visibility into technology execution.

Qualifications Guidelines:

Education/Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
5-7 years of experience in technology program management, preferably supporting commercial, consumer-facing, restaurant, retail, hospitality, or enterprise SaaS technology programs.
Experience coordinating cross-functional technology initiatives involving product, engineering, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors.
Familiarity with agile and waterfall delivery methodologies and experience coordinating teams using different development approaches.
Working knowledge of system integrations, including APIs, webhooks, middleware, and data feeds, sufficient to identify risks and support cross-vendor coordination.
Experience with restaurant, QSR, fast casual, multi-unit, CRM, digital ordering, loyalty, kiosk, or third-party delivery platforms preferred.

This is a hybrid role. Candidates must be able to commute to the office.

Language Ability: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required. The successful candidate must be able to produce clear program documentation, status reports, and executive presentations, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences, including software engineers, vendor teams, field operators, and C-suite leaders.
Math Ability: This position requires proficient business math and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret program data, track delivery metrics, and identify trends or risks from consolidated reporting across multiple workstreams.
Reasoning Ability: The position requires strong organizational thinking, the ability to manage complexity across multiple simultaneous programs, and sound judgment in identifying and escalating risks before they become problems. The candidate must be comfortable operating in ambiguity while keeping multiple teams coordinated and moving forward.
Computer Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite is required. Experience with program and project management tools, such as Jira, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or similar platforms, road mapping software, and cross-team collaboration platforms is preferred.
Supervisory Responsibilities: This position has no supervisory responsibilities.
Physical Demands: This position is primarily office-based and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position for prolonged periods while using a computer, telephone, and standard office equipment. The position may occasionally require standing, walking, reaching, grasping, handling objects, and lifting or moving up to 20 pounds. Travel to restaurant locations for discovery sessions, pilot testing, and field enablement may be required, with business needs potentially requiring travel up to 25% of the time. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Special Requirements/Certification: PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), or equivalent program/project management certification preferred but not required.
