BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference.

Our pride and dedication shows in everything we do—from intelligence analysis, cyber operations and IT expertise to systems development, systems integration, and operations and maintenance services. Position Summary

The Customer Service Operations Analyst is responsible for administering customer operational activities and business processes for assigned customers and programs within the Global One Source organization. This role serves as a key business partner between customers and internal stakeholders to ensure operational performance, customer commitments, and service expectations are achieved.

The Analyst evaluates customer requirements, operational performance, fulfillment challenges, and business risks to identify issues, determine appropriate corrective actions, and develop recommendations that improve customer outcomes and operational efficiency. The position exercises discretion and independent judgment in resolving customer issues, managing operational exceptions, evaluating performance trends, and implementing process improvements.

This role requires strong analytical capabilities, business acumen, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams to support customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and organizational growth.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Customer Operations Ownership

Manage operational activities for assigned customers, programs, and business processes.
Monitor customer operational performance to ensure service commitments, customer requirements, and business expectations are achieved.
Evaluate customer demand patterns, order activity, fulfillment performance, and operational trends to identify potential risks and opportunities.
Prioritize operational activities and recommend actions when competing customer demands or business constraints arise.
Serve as a primary point of contact for operational matters impacting assigned customers and programs.
Develop a comprehensive understanding of customer business requirements and operational objectives.

Business Issue Resolution and Decision Support

Evaluate operational exceptions, fulfillment challenges, customer concerns, and service disruptions to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions.

Develop recommendations that balance customer requirements with organizational objectives.
Exercise independent judgment when determining appropriate solutions and escalation pathways.

Operational Analysis and Performance Management

Develop insights and recommendations that support operational decision-making and continuous improvement efforts.
Monitor key performance indicators and identify areas requiring corrective action.
Conduct root cause analysis on recurring service, operational, or customer issues.

Evaluate customer and operational data to identify trends impacting performance, profitability, and customer experience.

Process Improvement and Operational Excellence

Evaluate existing workflows and operational processes to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
Recommend and implement process enhancements designed to improve operational effectiveness, scalability, accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
Lead initiatives that reduce recurring issues, improve workflow consistency, and support sustainable growth.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process documentation, and operational best practices.
Assess the effectiveness of implemented solutions and recommend additional improvements where appropriate.
Support business initiatives related to customer retention, operational performance, and strategic growth objectives.

Cross-Functional Business Partnership

Collaborate with Customer Service leadership, Purchasing, Sourcing, Operations, Logistics, and Finance teams to achieve customer and business objectives.
Provide operational expertise and recommendations regarding customer requirements, service commitments, and business risks.
Support implementation of new customer programs, process changes, and operational initiatives.
Facilitate communication and alignment among stakeholders to ensure successful execution of customer requirements.
Promote knowledge sharing and collaboration across the Global One Source organization.

Order and Customer Operations Administration

Manage customer order activity and related operational processes to support fulfillment and customer service objectives.
Review customer transactions and operational activity for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established business requirements.
Evaluate order-related issues and determine appropriate actions to support customer commitments and operational objectives.
Maintain the integrity of customer, pricing, and operational data within company systems.
Identify trends impacting order flow, workload distribution, and operational efficiency and recommend appropriate actions.

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About The Role

The Data Analyst II works with Client Services staff to process data changes upon request. The Data Analyst II is also responsible for delivering data transfers when needed. Demonstrates extreme attention to detail and organization in all aspects of work.
Responsible for executing data changes per request, either through backend database scripts or with the use of validated in-house Data Solution Tools.

Delivers client-requested database transfer datasets upon request.
Participates in meetings with appropriate Client Services and Technical Delivery team members as it relates to study implementation and maintenance.

Follow Bracket Standard Operating Procedures for data change management, data transfer verification and risk/impact assessment documentation.
Some data entry of data change requests may be required.
Technical support after-hours, on-call time is required at set intervals.
Participates in special data-related projects as needed.

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

Essential:

2-4 years of experience working in a data-driven environment.
In-depth working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL), as well as Microsoft Windows 2000/2003/XP/7 and the suite of Microsoft Office applications.
Experience with standard data mining and data presentation techniques.
Proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced work environment with minimal direct supervision.
Must have excellent written communication skills, including the ability to effectively document procedures, processes and results.
Must have excellent verbal communication skills, as interaction with team members occurs daily.
Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines & multi-task in a fast-paced work environment.
Demonstrate extreme attention to detail and organization in all aspects of work.
Must have very strong skills with Microsoft Office applications.
Must be comfortable working with business users and technical teams.
Ability to create and execute SQL Queries is required.

Desirable:

Familiarity with C# programming language is a plus.
Working knowledge of Visual Basic is a plus.
Familiarity with GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 is a plus.

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

jobs.description:
About Us

This is your chance to kickstart your career at HarrisX, at HarrisX, a leading technology, market research, and consulting company that blends corporate and public opinion research to uncover what drives people, brands, and policy. We specialize in understanding the connected consumer, running some of the most comprehensive studies on technology, telecom, and media behavior globally, while also serving as one of the most accurate pollsters in recent U.S. elections.

Our research combines quantitative and qualitative methods, behavioral data, and social analytics to deliver actionable insights to clients ranging from Fortune 100 corporations to media organizations, advocacy groups, and policymakers. Based in Washington DC and with offices in New York, Toronto, London, Los Angeles, Australia, and Singapore, HarrisX is a member of Stagwell Global.

Our mission is simple: To connect all the dots for our clients, in what we call “Connected Intelligence.”

Overview

As a Research Analyst on the Custom Research team at HarrisX, you will support end-to-end research engagements across corporate, media, and public opinion research projects. Working under the direction of a Research Manager, you will contribute to research design, build and program surveys, analyze data, and help develop client-ready deliverables.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role suited for someone early in their research career who is eager to develop technical depth across quantitative and qualitative methods. You will work as part of a collaborative project team alongside Research Managers, Directors, VPs, data scientists, and research operations team, contributing to studies that inform both corporate strategy and public narratives.

HarrisX offers strong growth opportunities for motivated analysts who are looking to build skills quickly and take on greater responsibility over time.

Responsibilities

Support the planning and execution of custom research projects, including timeline tracking, fieldwork coordination, and vendor management under the direction of a Research Manager.
Assist in the development of research instruments, including survey questionnaires and moderator guides, in line with established methodological standards.
Program surveys using platforms such as Decipher, Qualtrics, or ConfirmIT, and manage quality checks throughout the fieldwork process.
Clean, process, and analyze survey data using Q, SPSS, or equivalent statistical tools, applying appropriate weighting and validation techniques.
Contribute to the preparation of reports, presentations, and dashboards that translate findings into clear, actionable insights for client delivery.
Support the integration of multiple data sources, including survey, behavioral, and secondary data, as directed by senior team members.
Participate in client communications, documenting business objectives and project requirements under the guidance of a Research Manager or Director.
Collaborate cross-functionally with analysts, data scientists, and research operations colleagues across project workstreams.
Apply and develop familiarity with AI-powered tools used for survey automation, data synthesis, and content analysis as part of the team's evolving workflow.

Qualifications

You have 1–2 years of experience in custom market research, data analysis, or a related research environment.
You have academic and practical exposure to a range of research methodologies, including new product, brand, advertising, and customer satisfaction research.
You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint, and have working knowledge of Q, SPSS, SAS, or equivalent statistical software. Experience with R, Python, or data visualization tools is a plus.
You have hands-on experience programming surveys in platforms such as Decipher, Qualtrics, or ConfirmIT.
You understand survey methodology fundamentals, including best practices for questionnaire design, statistical weighting, and data validation.
You are comfortable working with multiple data types and have a foundation in data cleaning, analysis, and visualization.
You communicate clearly in both written and verbal form, and can present findings in a structured, accessible way.
You are detail-oriented, able to manage competing priorities under tight deadlines, and comfortable operating with some ambiguity.
You are curious about AI-powered tools and open to applying them within research workflows, including survey automation and data synthesis.
You hold a Bachelor's degree, preferably in economics, statistics, mathematics, political science, communications, or a related field. A Master's or advanced degree is a plus.

Job Description

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. As a Project Manager in the SDF (Service Delivery Framework) Roads team you’ll be working alongside a host of talented people ranging from our early career professionals to established engineers and project managers working across the Roads business to improve the local and strategic networks, based in our London & South East region (located in either of our: Cambridge, London (Westferry Circus), Basingstoke, Guildford or Southampton offices).

What is SDF? The National Highways Scheme Delivery Framework (SDF) is a multi-billion-pound procurement strategy used to maintain, renew, and improve England’s Strategic Road Network (SRN). It enables regional, collaborative, and performance-based contracts for works such as pavement, civil engineering, and technology to enhance safety and efficiency.

Being part of this framework team, you will lead the delivery of moderately complex projects, accountable for scope, schedule, budget, and resource management, while ensuring quality and compliance with WSP’s procedures and client requirements.

Ensure deliverables meet agreed quality standards and that reporting requirements are fulfilled. 
Manage project documentation, tracking milestones, resources, and change control. 
Mentor and upskill more junior staff helping them develop professionally and progress towards professional qualifications.
Work collaboratively with clients and key stakeholders as necessary to deliver the schemes/projects.

APM PMQ or equivalent qualification is not a prerequisite but will be greatly beneficial to the role. 

Proven experience managing projects with accountability for delivery of scope, schedule, budget, and resources. 

Understanding of NEC contracts or similar, with experience in contract administration and compliance. 

Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and communicate effectively with stakeholders. 

Competency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project) and a proactive approach to process improvement. 

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

The role requires strong facilitation skills, proactive risk identification, and the confidence to hold teams accountable. The ideal candidate is agile and flexible, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and brings a learning mindset—someone who takes detailed notes, asks the right questions, and builds deep understanding of the projects they support. You'll ensure the successful coordination and delivery of programs by maintaining alignment across workstreams, supporting stakeholder communications, coordinating UAT activities, surfacing gaps and risks early, and providing senior leadership with clear, actionable reporting. This role offers significant exposure to cross-functional program delivery and serves as a strong foundation for a career in strategic program management and business operations.

What your day-to-day will look like:

Own and maintain the integrated, non-technical project plan encompassing all workstreams, milestones, and deliverables while developing and managing the master project timeline to ensure alignment between operational readiness, change management, and product & engineering launch support activities
Track progress against milestones and proactively flag deviations, risks, or resource constraints while facilitating release planning sessions that ensure alignment on timelines, scope, and dependencies across all workstreams
Manage critical path activities and ensure sequencing of dependent deliverables (e.g., product & engineering feature completion → SOPs → training delivery) while coordinating go/no-go decision preparation with compiled readiness data from all workstreams
Serve as the single coordination point across product & engineering, operational readiness, and change management workstreams by maintaining dependency tracking and facilitating resolution across workstreams
Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts and resource constraints proactively while maintaining a decision log with follow-up tracking and facilitating cross-workstream alignment sessions with clear outcomes on timeline, scope, and dependency resolution
Conduct gap reviews with workstream leads to systematically identify what's missing, at risk, or blocked, and maintain centralized tracking showing owners, status, dependencies, timelines, and blockers for all deliverables
Develop mitigation plans when gaps are identified and drive them to resolution while proactively identifying emerging gaps before they become critical path issues
Provide bi-weekly consolidated status reports to senior leadership showing deliverable health, cross-workstream gaps, and needed escalations while developing and maintaining dashboard/reporting infrastructure providing real-time visibility into progress against milestones
Coordinate operational readiness activities including data collection (service matrices, system metadata, workflow documentation), track internal service delivery training material development and coordinate delivery, coordinate SOP strategy and delivery aligned to releases, manage FAQ development and content approval processes, and schedule and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across customers, service delivery partners, and internal teams
Support product & engineering launch activities by coordinating launch UAT testing logistics across all releases, facilitating defect triage coordination and severity assessment processes, coordinating launch day activities and issue escalation management, and tracking production environment cutover planning and execution
Maintain and actively manage the RAAIDD log (Risks, Assumptions, Actions, Issues, Dependencies, and Decisions) across all workstreams and releases, facilitate regular RAAIDD reviews with workstream leads to ensure timely identification, escalation, and resolution, and track dependency chains to proactively surface blockers
Support change management activities by tracking communication and engagement strategy delivery coordination, managing feedback collection mechanisms, coordinating participant engagement and readiness assessments, and supporting change impact analysis documentation and distribution.

Required Qualifications:

Demonstrated experience in project/program management for complex, cross-functional initiatives with proven success in coordinating multiple stakeholders
Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams with interdependent deliverables and competing timelines in dynamic environments
Experience with phased launch/rollout programs, ideally supporting technology platform implementations or enterprise system deployments
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without direct authority and build credibility across diverse teams
Excellent facilitation skills for cross-functional alignment sessions and decision-making forums with ability to drive meetings to actionable outcomes
Experience developing and maintaining integrated project plans, dependency maps, and critical path analyses with strong attention to detail
Proficiency in proactive risk identification, gap analysis, and mitigation planning with demonstrated ability to surface issues early
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level status reporting with ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable summaries
Demonstrated comfort with technology platforms, data dashboards, and emerging tools (e.g., AI-assisted workflows) with ability to quickly learn new systems and business contexts
Track record of driving accountability across teams and deliverable owners without direct authority through relationship-building and consistent follow-through.

Preferred Qualifications:

Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification demonstrating formal project management training and methodology expertise
Experience supporting technology platform launches within large-scale enterprise environments with multiple concurrent workstreams
Familiarity with change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci, ADKAR) and operational readiness frameworks
Experience coordinating across technical and non-technical teams where product & engineering operates independently (e.g., Agile/Scrum environments)
Background in event management or travel and meetings programs providing relevant business domain context
Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Asana, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar platforms
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain dashboards and reporting infrastructure that provides executive-level visibility.

ECM Program Manager

Pacific Health Group | Transforming Care Through Connection

At Pacific Health Group, we're more than just a healthcare organization—we're driving real change. As an ECM Program Manager, you'll lead our Enhanced Care Management program, making sure vulnerable populations get the care, support, and advocacy they need to live healthier, more stable lives. You'll guide regional teams to deliver compassionate, person-centered care that improves outcomes and supports our mission to close health equity gaps across California.

Role Overview

This position is all about leadership, program oversight, and innovation. You'll supervise Lead Care Managers, across the hiring county, ensuring the team has the support and resources needed to succeed. You'll oversee program quality, member services, cross-functional partnerships, budgeting, and program growth initiatives. Your work will directly impact the lives of high-need populations while strengthening Pacific Health Group's reputation for excellence in care.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Supervision

Mentor and guide Lead Care Managers across multiple counties.
Conduct weekly one-on-ones to address challenges, review caseloads, and provide coaching.
Lead weekly team meetings to share updates, review cases, and encourage collaboration.
Meet in-person with staff regularly to maintain strong leadership presence.

Program Development & Quality Assurance

Establish benchmarks and metrics to track program performance.
Implement quality assurance protocols and standardized workflows.
Monitor staff performance and use data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.

Member Services Oversight

Ensure members are receiving in-person visits and high-quality care.
Monitor documentation and provide support for challenging cases.
Implement strategies to improve member engagement and satisfaction.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Serve as liaison between ECM program and hospitals, providers, and community organizations.
Collaborate with data and compliance teams to track outcomes and maintain regulatory standards.
Strengthen partnerships to improve care transitions and reduce hospital readmissions.

Budget & Resource Management

Develop and manage program budgets, allocate resources efficiently, and track expenditures.
Adjust staffing and resources based on member needs and program priorities.

Program Innovation & Growth

Identify opportunities to enhance program effectiveness.
Pilot new initiatives such as telehealth to expand access to care.
Stay current on best practices and integrate improvements.

Additional Examples

Lead operational huddles and bi-weekly case conferences.
Develop mentorship programs and regional trainings for staff.
Prepare quarterly performance reports and maintain stakeholder relationships.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Nursing, or related field.
5+ years in healthcare management, including 3+ years in care/case management.
2+ years managing Enhanced Care Management or intensive care management programs.

Knowledge & Skills

Understanding of care management principles and healthcare delivery systems.
Experience with Medicaid/Medicare programs and ECM program requirements.
Strong analytical skills and experience in data-driven program evaluation.

Personal Attributes

Strong leadership and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Commitment to person-centered care and health equity.

Working Conditions

Regular travel (65%) to county sites in California.
Occasional evening or weekend availability for program initiatives

Compensation

Pay: $80,000 - $85,000 annual salary

Requirements

Must reside within hiring county

This role oversees the lifecycle of forward-deployed engineering engagements in which MongoDB Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) partner closely with customer engineering teams to build working agents.

It is a high-impact role at the intersection of customer delivery, AI agent development, and product feedback. By working closely with customers during implementation, the Sr. Technical Program Manager helps shape real-world agent outcomes, demonstrate the value of MongoDB’s platform in live enterprise environments, and bring back insights that can inform future product direction.

These engagements are designed to help customers realize business value from our platform, accelerate successful agent delivery, and generate product feedback through close collaboration during implementation.

The Sr. Technical Program Manager, FDE Engagements drives successful delivery by aligning stakeholders, managing risks and dependencies, removing operational blockers, and ensuring clear ownership, communication, and decision-making across the engagement lifecycle. In partnership with FDE, Product, Engineering, account teams, and customer stakeholders, this role is accountable for program execution and engagement outcomes.

If an action item does not yet have an explicitly assigned owner, the Sr. Technical Program Manager is responsible for driving assignment and follow-through until ownership is clear.

Pre-customer environment access

Main goals:

Secure access to the customer's internal collaboration and development tooling as early as possible
Align on the intended behavior, functionality, and architecture of the agents
Define how the FDE team and customer engineering team will collaborate on use case and architecture definition, code, and execution
Establish the deployment path for MongoDB’s tools across customer development and cloud environments
Confirm business goals, technical scope, and success criteria for the engagement

During this phase, the Sr. Technical Program Manager partners with the assigned FDE team, account teams, and customer stakeholders to coordinate onboarding requirements, dependency management, planning, and readiness activities. This may include coordinating statements of work, contractor onboarding steps, access approvals, and early execution planning.

The pre-access period should also be used to build a shared understanding of the business value, intended behavior, and technical architecture of the agent. The team should prepare the technical design inputs needed to break the work into executable tasks in the customer's preferred engineering collaboration environment.

Deliverables:

Engagement overview deck
Agent technical spec
Agent architecture
Mutually agreed-upon definition of success

Agent build and prototyping

Main goals

Enable the joint engineering team to develop agents locally and contribute to a shared code repository
Establish a viable path to deployment in MongoDB’s production environment
Support a single-team execution model across MongoDB and customer engineers
Provide structured status updates and feedback loops to internal product stakeholders

During this phase, the team should adapt to the customer’s preferred engineering collaboration model where it supports execution. FDEs may lead or contribute to technical workstreams, while the Sr. Technical Program Manager drives coordination, planning, risk management, communication, escalation and execution tracking across the engagement.

FDEs kick off this phase by running an onboarding session for the customer engineering team to ensure that local development setup is seamless. FDEs should then act as a leader or member of their engineering team to break out the work in the agents’ technical spec into tickets that are picked up by both the FDE and customer’s engineers.

One particular item to look out for are red tape and restrictions around cloud deployments. Since our customers are often regulated industries, we might need to work with VDIs and artifact repositories instead of our native Github tooling. It should be a priority to determine the path to deploying the agents once code complete.

Deliverables

Customer onboarding session
Engagement status updates and feedback to the Product team about issues or unmet needs
Working agent deployed onto the product, integrated into the customer’s cloud infrastructure

Readout and closeout of engagement

Main goals

Confirm long-term ownership of the agent
Ensure the customer has a roadmap for continued usage and development
Identify opportunities for future paid FDE engagement support where appropriate

Once the agent fulfills the initial engagement requirements, the team should prepare an engagement readout that demonstrates what was built, what business value was created, and what path exists for continued investment and adoption.

By the end of this phase, the customer should be positioned to continue development of the agent independently and to provide ongoing product feedback to MongoDB. Where appropriate, MongoDB may continue to support the customer through additional phases of the project.

Deliverables

Engagement readout deck
MongoDB-internal perspective on future FDE engagement opportunities

Qualifications

5+ years of experience leading complex technical programs or engineering initiatives from initiation through delivery, including planning, execution, and cross-functional coordination in customer-facing enterprise software, platform, infrastructure, or applied AI environments.
Working fluency in modern AI application architectures, including LLM-based workflows, retrieval and grounding patterns, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation approaches, with the ability to partner credibly with technical teams and scope technical tradeoffs
Demonstrated success operating in ambiguous, fast-changing technical environments and driving programs forward through structured planning, proactive dependency management, and clear decision-making
Strong ability to partner across Engineering, Product, customer stakeholders, and delivery teams to align goals, scope, priorities, timelines, and execution across the full engagement lifecycle, from onboarding and access planning through technical design, deployment, executive readouts, and transition to long-term ownership
Fluency in English, spoken and written
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear documentation, maintain durable decision records, tailor communication to technical, executive, and customer audiences, and connect technical delivery decisions to customer business value, adoption, and long-term growth opportunities

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in forward-deployed, embedded, or other high-touch customer delivery models
Experience working with regulated or operationally constrained customer environments, including enterprise access controls, non-standard development tooling, artifact repositories, and deployment governance

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. new_jobs.title: Deputy Program Manager - SOCOM
new_jobs.description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Job Overview

About Our Team

Programs partners closely with Growth, Engineering, Production, Procurement, Software, and Product teams to define scope, align resources, and manage cost, schedule, and risk. It's our collective, team-driven approach that powers execution to meet and exceed the expectations of our growing customer base. In an environment where things move fast and operate in open-ended, ambiguous problem spaces, we trust and empower each team member to operate independently and take full ownership of their work. When faced with roadblocks, each team member is expected to think critically and bring potential solutions to the table. When it comes to communication, the default is transparency; sharing context, decisions, and progress freely. Lastly, feedback flows in every direction; we experiment, question, and learn together by speaking directly and honestly.

About The Role

This is a hands-on role for someone who owns the details and gets the work done, and it is an ideal next step for a candidate ready to grow into a Program Manager. The position will be largely in-person, because close, face-to-face collaboration is how our SOCOM customers work best. A working understanding of maritime and/or autonomous systems (schematics, software, CAD, wiring diagrams, and system-level architecture) is highly beneficial for bridging communications and understanding of various lines of effort across technical, operational, and administrative teams. The DPM may support one or more lines of effort across multiple SOCOM-focused contracts at once.

Responsibilities

Scoping & Scheduling

Partner with Growth to translate SOCOM opportunities and customer demand into clear, defensible scope and schedules.
Support proposal inputs, including scope, statements of work, and basis of estimate, ensuring what we propose is technically grounded, executable, and aligned to strategic, engineering, and timeline realities.
Build and maintain work breakdown structures and execution schedules that connect growth commitments to engineering and production reality.

Program Execution

Support the Program Manager across all five process groups (initiation, planning, execution, monitoring & control, and closeout) on one or more concurrent programs.
Track schedules, requirements, budgets, deliverables, and integration milestones, including Government- and Contractor-Furnished Equipment (GFE/CFE).
Coordinate design, build, on-water testing, and readiness activities to meet contract milestones, and de-risk critical path items.
Maintain configuration and documentation compliance across all program phases.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Serve as a day-to-day point of contact across Engineering, Production, Quality, and Training, communicating objectives, milestones, and changes so everyone knows what they own and when.
Lead recurring coordination meetings to keep execution aligned to the delivery schedule.
Engage confidently in technical discussions and interpret engineering documentation (BOMs, CAD, wire diagrams) to resolve issues and keep teams aligned.
Relay feedback from field operations, testing, and customer reviews back to internal teams for continuous improvement.

Risk, Compliance & Field Support

Identify, track, and help mitigate program risks and issues, maintaining risk registers and after-action reports across assigned programs.
Work with Contracts and Legal to keep scope, terms, and deliverables (CDRLs) accurately captured and compliant with contractual, DoD, ABS, and DCMA standards.
Support field operations, demos, and test events (readiness, integration, documentation, and after-action reviews), plus sustainment and logistics planning that keeps fielded systems mission-ready for operators downrange.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Naval Architecture, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
5+ years in program management, preferably in a defense, engineering, or technical environment, including support to SOF or SOCOM programs.
Familiarity with DoD program requirements, government contracting, and recognized program management standards.
Working knowledge of maritime and/or autonomous systems, with the ability to read technical documentation and engage credibly with engineers.
3+ years working across software-based toolsets, including MS Project, the MS Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), Confluence, and communicating with cross functional teams via Slack and other applications.
A bias for action and ownership in a fast-paced, high-trust, rapidly growing environment.
Willingness to travel up to 35% of the time.
Secret security clearance eligibility required, active preferred.

Preferred Qualification

PMP certification or demonstrated command of project management first principles and the five process groups.
Program management experience in shipbuilding, naval systems, unmanned systems, undersea systems, robotics, or other autonomous hardware prototyping or production focused efforts.
Direct SOF/SOCOM experience, with familiarity with SOF-peculiar requirements, mission planning, and sustainment/logistics systems.
Experience across multiple acquisition pathways, including FAR-based contracts, OTAs, and rapid prototyping authorities.
Direct service-branch background in program management, acquisitions, or SOF operations.
Advanced degree, or foreign language proficiency (e.g., Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, or Arabic).

Physical Demands

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Occasional standing and walking within the office
Manual dexterity to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment
Visual acuity to read screens, documents, and reports
Occasional reaching, bending, or stooping to access file drawers, cabinets, or office supplies

Industry-standard salaries with opportunities for performance-based bonuses

Basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager – Digital Products
new_jobs.description:
The Technical Program Manager serves as the coordinating force across commercial and consumer-facing technology programs spanning the Restaurant Technology and Digital product teams. Embedded within the Restaurant Technology team and reporting to the VP of Restaurant Technology, this role ensures initiatives—including point-of-sale, digital ordering, customer relationship management, loyalty management, kiosks, promotions, delivery channel integrations, and consumer-facing applications—are delivered in a coordinated, sequenced, and business-aligned manner. This role facilitates cross-team planning, manages program interdependencies and risks, maintains enterprise-wide visibility into commercial technology delivery, and supports technical decision-making across internal engineering and vendor technical teams by surfacing trade-offs and driving alignment on integration approaches and dependencies. This high-visibility role sits at the intersection of technology execution and guest-facing business impact and requires organizational rigor and sufficient technical fluency to keep cross-team technical conversations productive.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Cross-Team Planning & Coordination
Maintain a unified program calendar across all Restaurant Technology and Digital product workstreams, surfacing timeline conflicts, resource overlaps, and sequencing risks.
Facilitate recurring cross-team planning sessions with product managers and program managers to align on priorities and dependencies.
Facilitate technical alignment discussions between internal engineering and vendor technical leads when integration approaches, architecture choices, or system dependencies require resolution; surface trade-offs and drive the group toward a decision or clear escalation path.
Translate executive priorities from the VP of Restaurant Technology into coordinated action plans distributed across the appropriate product and program owners.

Vendor & Partner Program Coordination
Coordinate scheduling and preparation for vendor roadmap sessions, sprint reviews, and performance reviews, ensuring the right internal stakeholders are engaged.
Track vendor delivery commitments across all active programs and flag deviations or risks to the appropriate product manager or program manager.
Maintain a consolidated vendor activity log across Restaurant Technology and Digital, giving the VP of Restaurant Technology a single view of third-party status.
Support RFP/RFI processes by coordinating internal inputs, managing review timelines, and ensuring cross-team participation in vendor evaluations.
Monitor and communicate upcoming vendor release windows, ensuring all impacted teams—including Digital, Operations, and Field Enablement—are informed and prepared.

Stakeholder & Digital Team Alignment
Serve as the primary coordination point between the Restaurant Technology team and the broader organization, including Digital Product, the CDO organization, PMO, Business Analysts, and other stakeholders, by facilitating joint planning sessions and managing cross-team dependencies.
Act as the liaison between technology teams and Field Enablement, ensuring training plans, rollout communications, and readiness checklists are developed and tracked for all releases.
Engage cybersecurity, compliance, and legal stakeholders proactively to ensure all programs maintain appropriate review timelines and approval gates.

Program & Release Coordination
Own the enterprise technology release calendar, coordinating go/no-go readiness across all active programs and ensuring releases are properly sequenced to minimize operational disruption at the restaurant level.
Facilitate UAT planning and pilot coordination across workstreams, tracking readiness milestones and communicating status to all stakeholders.
Produce and distribute release communications to field operations, franchise partners, and internal teams for all technology deployments.
Track post-release issues across programs and coordinate resolution efforts between the relevant product manager, vendor, and support teams.

Visibility, Reporting & Escalation
Produce weekly and monthly program status reports for the VP of Restaurant Technology, summarizing progress, risks, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all active workstreams.
Maintain a consolidated risk and issues log across all Restaurant Technology and Digital programs, tracking escalation status and resolution timelines.
Contribute program coordination and delivery data to operations intelligence products to support leadership visibility into technology execution.

Qualifications Guidelines:

Education/Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
5-7 years of experience in technology program management, preferably supporting commercial, consumer-facing, restaurant, retail, hospitality, or enterprise SaaS technology programs.
Experience coordinating cross-functional technology initiatives involving product, engineering, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors.
Familiarity with agile and waterfall delivery methodologies and experience coordinating teams using different development approaches.
Working knowledge of system integrations, including APIs, webhooks, middleware, and data feeds, sufficient to identify risks and support cross-vendor coordination.
Experience with restaurant, QSR, fast casual, multi-unit, CRM, digital ordering, loyalty, kiosk, or third-party delivery platforms preferred.

This is a hybrid role. Candidates must be able to commute to the office.

Language Ability: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required. The successful candidate must be able to produce clear program documentation, status reports, and executive presentations, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences, including software engineers, vendor teams, field operators, and C-suite leaders.
Math Ability: This position requires proficient business math and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret program data, track delivery metrics, and identify trends or risks from consolidated reporting across multiple workstreams.
Reasoning Ability: The position requires strong organizational thinking, the ability to manage complexity across multiple simultaneous programs, and sound judgment in identifying and escalating risks before they become problems. The candidate must be comfortable operating in ambiguity while keeping multiple teams coordinated and moving forward.
Computer Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite is required. Experience with program and project management tools, such as Jira, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or similar platforms, road mapping software, and cross-team collaboration platforms is preferred.
Supervisory Responsibilities: This position has no supervisory responsibilities.
Physical Demands: This position is primarily office-based and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position for prolonged periods while using a computer, telephone, and standard office equipment. The position may occasionally require standing, walking, reaching, grasping, handling objects, and lifting or moving up to 20 pounds. Travel to restaurant locations for discovery sessions, pilot testing, and field enablement may be required, with business needs potentially requiring travel up to 25% of the time. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Special Requirements/Certification: PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), or equivalent program/project management certification preferred but not required.
The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions and perform other related duties as assigned by their supervisor, policy, or company management. Work location and onsite attendance requirements will be determined by the company in accordance with company practice and business needs.

Summary

Redwire Space Missions, LLC is seeking an experienced Sr. Project Manager based in the Denver, CO area to
support multiple programs with a strong background in DoD and commercial satellite program execution
, including experience delivering space vehicles, mission payloads, or ground segment products
for government agencies such as the Space Development Agency (SDA), U.S. Space Force, AFRL, or NASA
. This leader will guide complex space programs from concept through on‑orbit operations, ensuring execution consistent with technical, schedule, and contractual requirements. This is considered an onsite role, based out of our Littleton, CO. office. You must have an active DOD security clearance or the ability to obtain one.

Responsibilities

Lead execution of DoD, SDA, and commercial satellite programs, ensuring compliance with government contractual requirements, milestone reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR, ORR), and interface control processes.
Manage spacecraft development efforts including bus, payload, integration & test, and launch campaign coordination.
Oversee program performance against Earned Value Management (EVM) principles when required for government programs.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, Gantt charts, and milestone tracking aligned with program objectives; ensure cross‑functional alignment through clear communication and expectation setting.
Manage supplier and subcontractor deliverables related to hardware, tooling, and test systems, including relationship management, performance oversight, and issue resolution.
Coordinate with internal stakeholder, government customers, and integrators; maintaining alignment of scope, capability delivery timelines, and security requirements.

Develop project budgets and resource plans; proactively manage resource allocation across competing priorities and provide monthly variance reporting on ETC and EAC.
Identify and mitigate risks, proactively preparing for potential project issues and scope creep; facilitate conflict resolution and decision‑making to maintain program momentum.
Ensure full compliance with cybersecurity, OPSEC, ITAR, and government reporting obligations across program activities.

Ideal Experience

Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, Jira) and ERP systems.
Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) in Engineering, Physics, or related technical field.
8 or more years of experience managing satellite or spacecraft development programs for DoD, NASA, or commercial space customers.
Experienced at delivering on SDA, U.S. Space Force, AFRL, or similar government space contracts.
Deep familiarity with spacecraft systems, to include but not limited to avionics, communications payloads, optical payloads, power systems, integration and test, environmental qualification, and mission operations.
Experience with project management tools (MS Project, Primavera, Jira) and ERP systems.

US Citizen or US Person as defined by ITAR regulations, with the ability to obtain a DOD security clearance.

Advanced to expert level user preferred Microsoft Project and Excel.
PMP certification preferred.

Pay Range

$120,000 - $190,000/Yr.

How We Determine What We Pay (Compensation Philosophy)

Redwire determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data, for our locations throughout the US. We will evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index, in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company.

For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will be considered for higher pay.

new_jobs.title: Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)
new_jobs.description:
We were early to the fight against Ubiquitous Technical Surveillance, and we’ve been pushing the edge ever since.

Our mission is to help government and enterprise organizations understand and manage commercial data risks, shape their digital signatures, and operate with confidence in an increasingly complex information landscape. We build and integrate advanced, tech-forward solutions to problems our customers often don’t know they have – until it matters most.

We move fast, think critically, and deliver where it counts.

What’s in it for you?

We work hard and do fun things.

You’ll work on high-impact, technically challenging problems alongside a team that values teamwork over competition. Veilant offers a solid work-life balance and flexible remote work options. At Veilant, you’ll work with the most talented software developers, systems engineers, and subject matter experts, building tools and systems that make a real difference.

Job Description

At most organizations, security accreditation shows up at the end of a program — a paperwork sprint to get an ATO signed before a deadline, run by someone who wasn't in the room when the architecture was decided.

That's not the job here.

Veilant is rethinking how cyber security and assurance get delivered across mission and enterprise systems, and we're looking for the person who will lead that shift. You'll be the primary security advisor and the trusted bridge between our Information Security Program and our government mission partners — the person engineering teams consult before they commit to a design, and the person our customers call when a hard question about risk or compliance lands on their desk.

If you've spent years watching RMF get treated as a compliance tax and you know it can be run as a discipline that actually makes systems better, this is the role where you get to prove it.

What you'll own

RMF accreditation, end to end.
You are the lead for every in-scope system — authoring and maintaining System Security Plans, policies, and procedures; building ATO packages; writing the justifications; assembling evidence; walking auditors through reviews; answering the government's questions directly; and keeping continuous monitoring running long after the authorization is signed.

Compliance integrity.
You'll review systems on a regular cadence for drift from documented configurations and procedures, report what you find without softening it, and drive remediation to closure.

Regulatory authority.
You'll be the person in the building who knows what NIST CSF, SP 800-171, SP 800-53, CMMC, and the DoD Zero Trust Mandate actually require — and, more usefully, what they mean for the system in front of you.

Security as a design input.
You'll identify security requirements early and get them built into architecture rather than bolted on. You'll advise mission teams on how their work maps to authorization processes — software, wireless, cloud approvals — so nobody discovers a blocker three weeks before delivery.

What success looks like in your first six months

A complete inventory of in-scope systems and their current authorization posture, with a prioritized roadmap for what needs attention and in what order
At least one system carried through ATO or reauthorization under your ownership
SSPs and supporting documentation current and defensible for every system you own
A continuous monitoring rhythm operating on a predictable cadence, with reporting your government partners actually rely on
Established as the advisor mission and engineering teams bring in early — not after the design is locked

How we'll measure your impact

Authorizations delivered on schedule, with no lapses in ATO coverage
Audit and assessment findings closed within agreed timelines, with POA&M burn-down trending down
Government partners raise security questions to you directly, and get answers they can act on
Security requirements appear in architecture reviews before they appear in findings

Qualifications

What you bring

Active TS/SCI with Polygraph. This is a hard requirement — we're unable to consider candidates without a current clearance at this level.
A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent hands-on experience.
5+ years of progressively increasing responsibility supporting cybersecurity, information assurance, risk management, or compliance for classified and unclassified programs, within the U.S. Government or as a cleared contractor.
Direct RMF experience — you've built ATO packages, not just contributed to them, and you've owned the relationship with an authorizing official.
Applied technical depth in one or more of: cloud and external services, system administration, configuration management, system and network architecture, operational technology, wireless, telecommunications security, supply chain risk, or security analysis tooling (Splunk, Nessus, Wireshark, and the like).
Communication that lands with both audiences. You can brief a room of engineers and a room of executives on the same risk, and both walk out knowing what to do next.
Willingness to work predominantly on-site in cleared facilities in Northern Virginia.

What Sets You Apart

Experience standing up or maturing a security program rather than maintaining an established one
CISSP, CISM, or equivalent certification
Direct experience implementing DoD Zero Trust requirements or CMMC readiness
A track record of turning a skeptical mission team into a partner

Additional Information

Why Join Veilant

This is an opportunity to shape a new commercial product function from the ground up. You will not simply inherit a roadmap — you will help define where Veilant goes next.

For the right person, this is a high-impact role with direct visibility to leadership and the opportunity to turn proven, mission-critical technologies into scalable commercial products.

What is the Compensation Range for this role?

The salary range for this position is $190,000 to $232,000 annually
for full-time status. Actual compensation within this range at Veilant is determined by numerous factors including but not limited to the candidate's qualifications, including experience, education, certifications, technical skills, as well as contract-specific affordability and labor categories, the scope and responsibilities of the role, market and business considerations, and geographic location.

Here are some Perks!

Flexible PTO + holidays
Generous 401k match benefit up to 10%, with an automatic 3% safe harbor contribution and additional matching based on employee contributions.
Medical (HSA & PPO Plans Available), dental, vision, disability, and life insurance

Learning & Development opportunities
Professional coaching services
Get the technology you want to do your job
We have free daily snacks & drinks

Constantly work with computers and other information technology equipment

new_jobs.description:
We’re ASOS, the online retailer for fashion lovers all around the world.

We exist to give our customers the confidence to be whoever they want to be, and that goes for our people too. At ASOS, you’re free to be your true self without judgement, and channel your creativity into a platform used by millions.

But how are we showing up? We’re proud members of Inclusive Companies, are Disability Confident Committed and have signed the Business in the Community Race at Work Charter and we placed 8th in the Inclusive Top 50 Companies Employer list.

Everyone needs some help showing up as their best self. Let our Talent team know if you need any adjustments throughout the process in whatever way works best for you.

Job Description

You’ll be supporting our Physical Security Department, in the protection of our ASOSers, our properties and our assets. You’ll support both office and field-based teams, ensuring we minimise risk and reduce loss across our offices and supply chain. You will be provided with development in loss reduction and risk mitigation techniques. This will include risk assessment completion, investigation support, site visits and the use of some of the most advanced security systems available. You’ll need to have a flexible approach to ensure that the operational needs of the business are maintained and support the departments operational requirements. You will also be encouraged to grow your own performance and support in your continuous development.

At ASOS, we are committed to delivering amazing products and fashion inspiration to our customers globally. Occasionally, we identify risks that could, if left unmitigated, lead to disappointment for our customers or loss to ASOS. The Physical Security Team, aim to identify and mitigate these risks, to ensure a great experience for both our customers and ASOSers. As a team, we strive to mitigate risk with minimal disruption to ASOSers and customers, through innovation and co-operation. We are, trustworthy and discrete. Our aim is to be the best provider of risk mitigation and security, amongst our peers. We do this through great collaboration and partnership with our other departments and external agencies.

The Details

Sharing in the responsibility for maintaining the ongoing reliability, performance and support of the physical security systems and related compliance requirements
Assisting with the integration, administration, and development of security systems including access control, CCTV, intrusion detection systems, video intercom systems, turnstiles, and related software applications
Support the Security Manager with preventive maintenance to reduce downtime for systems and devices
Assisting with the maintenance and improvement of security operational documents and procedures, managing documents within the department’s SharePoint environment
Working with 3rd party suppliers with travel risk assessments and threat mitigation
Utilising Open-Source Intelligence to monitor and react to potential threats to the business
Demonstrate the reduction of loss within your business area, through analysis and collaboration, using data visualisation tools
Assisting with creating, implementing, and managing procedural and security control documents along with the collation of associated evidence needed for compliance audits
Producing ad-hoc reports to evidence live issues and offer solutions
Assisting the Internal Audit & Risk team in incident response planning
Involvement in investigations, from information gathering, to filing police reports, collecting evidence, and testifying in court
Assisting the Security Manager to build and deploy counter-terrorism training to key areas of the business, including working with Counterterrorism and other external agencies
Assessing business trips taken to identify anomalies for further investigations to minimise future risk
Coordinating with other workgroups, projects, and initiatives which may impact physical security
Conducting security assessments of various facilities through vulnerability testing and risk analysis. Identifying threats and vulnerabilities and working with the Security team to formulate security mitigation options
Supporting our culture by championing Diversity, Equity & Inclusion strategies.

Qualifications

A passion to build upon existing skillsets of loss and risk reduction
Ability to manage workloads and priorities
Good attention to detail
The ability to work and communicate effectively in a team
Ensuring implementation of department strategy
Work in confidence in a sometimes-high pressured environment
A basic understanding of CCTV and Access Control systems
The flexibility to work outside normal business hours if required
A passion to want to be an ambassador for the ASOS brand, positively applying our values and behaviours
The ability to operate with trust and integrity

Employee sample sales

Private medical care scheme
Fixed Annual Payment in addition to your salary each year, it's just an extra thank you from us

Job Description

Project Manager – Product Development

At Axis our employees are innovative, dedicated and energetic and that’s just the beginning. Our employees are the driving force of the company and seek to move it forward towards the goal of being number one in our industry. As the global market leader in network video, Axis is driving the industry by continually launching innovative network products based on an open platform - delivering high value to its customers.

We are looking for a Project Manager
to our Fixed Cameras & Radar product development area with focus on the development of new network cameras and radar products.

Who is your future team?

The Fixed Cameras & Radar product area is focused on development of new Box & Bullet style cameras from idea to mass production. We are also responsible for development of radar products and audio functionality which includes HW and SW. The typical team member has a master's degree in engineering and works in roles such as software engineer, electronics engineer, mechanical engineer, technical lead, imaging engineer, project manager or line manager. Our product development projects also include crucial members as industrial lead, production test engineer, sourcing engineer and quality engineer.

What you’ll do here as Project Manager?

Our product development teams within the Fixed Camera & Radar product are fully committed to development of new state of the art network cameras.

As a Project Manager you will lead product development projects ranging all the way from idea, through conceptual design, execution phase, industrialization and finally volume production. The projects include development of electronics, mechanics and software as well as a wide range of competence areas such as quality assurance, industrial design, production tests, industrialization and regulatory approvals.

The role entails a great responsibility where you as Project Manager are responsible for the entire product project. At the same time, you need to engage and interact with all project members to understand their challenges and part of your project.

Your main tasks and responsibilities will be to:

Handle day-to-day project management activities like planning, risk mitigation, and follow up of project progress
Lead and motivate the project team towards successful goal completion
Actively look for solutions and drive decision making
Work with the product owner to refine product ideas and requirements

You will report to the Director for Fixed Cameras & Radar.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for you, that combine interest in people and project management with interest in new technology. You are a person that give energy to your colleagues and make sure that your team performs and succeeds! You are honest, open minded and ready to take full responsibility for your assignments.

The right candidate has work experience from project management in product development projects. It is considered an extra plus if previous experiences involve a background from software development.

You communicate easily in both Swedish and English, verbally and written.

This is a great opportunity to use and develop your skills in project management as part of an exciting, successful organization that is already the world leader in network video. Experience planning, budgeting, and scoping projects

new_jobs.description:
Entity

Technology

IT&S Group

Job Description

You will work with

The Transformation, Analytics and Insights (TAI) team reports directly to the EVP Technology and is distributed globally across US, UK, India and Malaysia. Our team Credo brings us together to ensure that we work as one team together regardless of location. This role will be part of the Business Transformation Enablement team. The team delivers pan-Technology transformation and divestment stranded cost priorities. We work closely with SVPs, VPs and cross-functional partners to turn strategic priorities into integrated plans, clear governance, accountable delivery and measurable outcomes. The team brings structure to transformation projects by coordinating execution across Technology, managing risks and dependencies, tracking progress, and helping ensure transformation, cost and stranded-cost commitments are delivered. We operate at pace, build trusted relationships across Technology, and support each other with honesty, care and a strong one-team mindset.

Let me tell you about the role

Technology is central to bp’s evolution as AI, geopolitical shifts and changing energy demand reshape how we work, deliver value and support the business.

This role works with Technology leadership and cross-functional partners to deliver priority transformation initiatives, strengthen execution across the portfolio, and help eliminate stranded costs from known divestments.

A Project Manager at bp delivers products, platforms and services using structured delivery methods, including Agile. The role connects strategy to execution by building practical plans, managing risks and dependencies, aligning stakeholders, and balancing competing priorities to achieve successful outcomes.

What you will deliver

Project and programme management: Develop and implement detailed project plans, including schedules, budgets, resource allocation, and delivery roadmaps. Use appropriate methodologies to deliver projects on time, within budget, and at the desired quality. Coordinate across teams to ensure project alignment with bp’s strategic objectives.
Delivery oversight in Agile environments: Work within Agile frameworks to align project milestones with iterative delivery cycles. Coordinate across multiple teams to track progress, resolve dependencies, and ensure continuous delivery of value. Support Agile practices at the organizational level by fostering collaboration and adaptability.
Risk and change management: Identify, evaluate, and mitigate risks to project success. Proactively address issues and adapt plans to manage changes effectively while ensuring project objectives remain achievable.
Stakeholder alignment and engagement: Build strong relationships with business, technical, and external partners to maintain alignment on goals, requirements, and delivery priorities. Act as a communication link between partners to ensure clarity and focus throughout the project lifecycle.
Continuous improvement and process optimization: Lead efforts to refine project management practices, focusing on repeatable and measurable processes. Drive initiatives to improve delivery efficiency, reduce risks, and enhance project outcomes while maintaining a culture of continuous improvement.

What you will need to be successful (experience and qualifications)

Great communication with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and effectively.
Excellent problem-solving with the ability to think strategically and make data-driven decisions.
Strong leadership and relationship skills, able to motivate and inspire cross-functional teams.

At this level, the Project Manager is delivering multiple concurrent initiatives. They apply strategic thinking to programme and project management, ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals. Stakeholder management involves influencing senior leadership and aligning cross-functional teams to shared objectives. They are strategically applying mixed methodologies (Agile, Waterall, etc.) to drive delivery and maintain team focus. They demonstrate leadership in systems development, ensuring robust, enduring solutions meet technical and business needs. They are beginning to mentor and develop junior members of the team, with an eye on growth and continuous improvement.

Preferred Experience

Significant experience in project management or related field, leading projects with increasing scope and complexity.
Proven track record of managing large-scale projects and navigating organizational complexity.
Proficiency in advanced Agile techniques, including scaling frameworks.
Expertise in systems development and change management.

About Bp

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.

What We Offer

Location:

Bangalore,IND

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Role Summary / Purpose

The TPRM Operations Analyst supports execution of the third-party risk management (TPRM) lifecycle by overseeing qualification assessments, managing workflows on the risk platform, and ensuring onboarding, monitoring, and offboarding activities are completed accurately and on time.

Reporting to the Global Third Party Risk Management Lead, the analyst provides day-to-day operational execution and user support: tracking request escalations, coordinating with risk stakeholders, and keeping the TPRM process running smoothly on the platform. The analyst also supports small-to-medium project delivery, user training, and process improvements that mature the program.

Key Responsibilities

TPRM Operations & Stakeholder Support

Support execution of the TPRM lifecycle (intake → assessment → monitoring → offboarding).
Oversee operations for qualification assessments and due-diligence activities across risk domains.
Track progress of requests and ensure completion within defined SLAs.
Act as a point of escalation and user support for day-to-day TPRM inquiries, assisting Category Managers, Relationship Owners, and business users with intake requests, status updates, and process guidance.
Help unblock requests by identifying missing information, delays, or dependencies and coordinating next steps.

Reporting & Compliance

Maintain and update TPRM tracking logs, dashboards, and reports.
Track key operational metrics (e.g., volume, cycle time, assessment status).
Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and audit-ready documentation within TPRM systems.
Validate completeness of required documentation, approvals, and risk assessments in alignment with TPRM policies, procedures, and controls.
Support audit requests by gathering documentation and maintaining records.

Analysis, Problem-Solving & Continuous Improvement

Analyze operational trends and metrics (e.g., volume, cycle time, assessment outcomes) to surface patterns, bottlenecks, and emerging third-party risks.
Root-cause recurring operational issues and proactively propose workflow and process improvements.
Support and deliver small-to-medium TPRM enhancements including process updates, workflow improvements, reporting enhancements, and tool configuration in partnership with Process and Technology teams.
Track project milestones, actions, and deliverables while coordinating across stakeholders to ensure timely delivery.
Escalate delays, risks, or issues to the Global Third Party Risk Management Lead and senior team members as needed.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Risk/Compliance, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
4–7 years of experience in Procurement Operations, Vendor Management, Risk/Compliance, Program Support, or a similar function.
Experience working in process-driven or workflow-based environments.
Demonstrated analytical ability — comfortable working with data to identify trends, root-cause issues, and recommend improvements.
Strong data discipline and comfort working with systems, trackers, and reporting tools.

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to SAP Ariba, ServiceNow, or TPRM/Risk Management platforms such as OneTrust, Exiger, Interos, etc.
Data-analysis skills for operational reporting and trend analysis.
Familiarity with third-party and supplier risk concepts and due diligence.
Foundational risk or compliance training.
Experience supporting audits or control documentation.

Key Skills / Competencies

Strong organizational and coordination skills; manages multiple workflows and priorities simultaneously.
Analytical mindset: analyzes trends, root-causes issues, and proposes improvements.
Attention to detail and data accuracy.
Execution-focused and service-oriented; responsive and helpful to stakeholders.
Proactive: follows up, removes blockers, and ensures high-quality data and documentation.
Growth-oriented: eager to build risk and program-management depth.
