About The Company

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do, but we can’t achieve our customer focused strategy without the right people in our team.

At Secure Trust Bank, we know that people are our biggest Asset, which is why a career with us is not just a job. It’s the chance to be part of something bigger, to add real value to the Bank and help us constantly improve. We believe in giving our staff autonomy, with initiative and exceptional performance recognised through a variety of individual and team awards and incentives. All our employees have a tangible impact on the Group’s core values, and we are looking for candidates who are enthusiastic, proactive and enjoy working in a fast paced environment.

Why Join Us?

A competitive salary and benefits package including discretionary bonus
Matched pension contributions
25 days annual leave plus bank holidays and your birthday off, on us!
A monthly wellbeing hour to spend doing whatever makes you happy
A wide range of flexible benefits from Cycle2Work to private healthcare
Life assurance
Paid volunteering days and matched charity fundraising
A collaborative and flexible working environment
Opportunities for professional development and career progression
A chance to make a real impact in a regulated, purpose-driven organisation Join us at Secure Trust Bank Group and help shape the future of responsible lending

At Secure Trust Bank we’re transforming how we make lending decisions through data, analytics and technology.

We’re building a modern Credit Strategy and Decision Science capability that combines commercial thinking, advanced analytics and automation to deliver better outcomes for our customers.

What you`ll be doing

As a Senior Credit Strategy Analyst
, you’ll play a key role in shaping lending decisions across our Consumer Finance portfolios. You’ll have ownership of credit strategies, influence portfolio performance and work across both established and evolving lending propositions, helping us identify new opportunities and develop strategies that support responsible, sustainable growth.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems, taking ownership and helping shape the future direction of a growing lending business. This is a hands-on strategy role focused on shaping lending decisions, not simply reporting on performance.

Own, develop and optimise credit risk strategies across the customer lifecycle.
Lead analytical investigations to identify portfolio trends, risks and commercial opportunities.
Support the ongoing optimisation of the V12 retail finance portfolio through data-driven strategy changes.
Support the development of embedded finance propositions through robust credit strategy and analytical insight.
Monitor portfolio performance and recommend strategy changes that improve customer and commercial outcomes.
Produce high-quality analysis and recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Use SQL, Python, SAS or similar analytical tools to solve business problems and automate processes.
Work closely with Decision Scientists to understand predictive models and ensure strategies maximise model performance.
Support junior analysts in their day-to-day analytical and risk management activities
Collaborate with Finance, Product, Operations and Technology to deliver strategic initiatives.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve processes, automation and customer outcomes. Why This Role Matters

Our Credit Strategy team sits at the heart of lending decisions, balancing commercial growth with responsible lending.

You’ll be trusted to own strategy, identify opportunities through analytics and work closely with Decision Science, Product, Finance and Operations to continuously improve customer outcomes and portfolio performance.

As our lending propositions continue to evolve, you’ll have the opportunity to influence how we lend, manage risk and deploy increasingly sophisticated analytical and decisioning capabilities.

What we`re looking for

Degree (or equivalent experience) in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering or another quantitative discipline.
Extensive experience in Credit Risk Strategy, Portfolio Analytics or Decision Science.
Experience developing and optimising credit strategies within consumer lending.
Strong understanding of portfolio management, underwriting strategies and customer lifecycle optimisation.
Experience using Credit Reference Agency data and decisioning systems.
Strong SQL skills with experience in SAS, Python or similar analytical tools.
Experience producing insight for senior stakeholders and influencing business decisions.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience across unsecured consumer lending, personal loans, retail finance or other consumer credit products would be advantageous.
Experience supporting new lending propositions, product launches, partnerships or new distribution channels would be beneficial.
Experience assessing new credit opportunities and translating analysis into practical lending strategies would be advantageous.

Everyone is different. Everyone is valued

As part of our vision to become the most trusted specialist lender in the UK, we’ve been helping customers and businesses fulfil their ambitions since 1952. In that time, we’ve learned that we’re more than the sum of our parts. We’re a strong Group because of our people being our strength; specialist, expert, ambitious and also diverse. All of our people are different and this is something we celebrate.

Every one of our employees brings unique talent, ability and perspective to their role.

That’s why Secure Trust Bank Group nurtures differences. We understand that we perform better because we’re not cast from the same mould. We actively embrace and support diversity, work with leading industry bodies and promote initiatives that reinforce our philosophy of giving you the freedom to be who you are.

We’re an award-winning bank providing savings accounts and lending services to over one million customer. We’re Secure Trust Bank Group. We embrace difference.

new_jobs.title: Enhanced Care Management Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
ECM Program Manager

Pacific Health Group | Transforming Care Through Connection

At Pacific Health Group, we're more than just a healthcare organization—we're driving real change. As an ECM Program Manager, you'll lead our Enhanced Care Management program, making sure vulnerable populations get the care, support, and advocacy they need to live healthier, more stable lives. You'll guide regional teams to deliver compassionate, person-centered care that improves outcomes and supports our mission to close health equity gaps across California.

Role Overview

This position is all about leadership, program oversight, and innovation. You'll supervise Lead Care Managers, across the hiring county, ensuring the team has the support and resources needed to succeed. You'll oversee program quality, member services, cross-functional partnerships, budgeting, and program growth initiatives. Your work will directly impact the lives of high-need populations while strengthening Pacific Health Group's reputation for excellence in care.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Supervision

Mentor and guide Lead Care Managers across multiple counties.
Conduct weekly one-on-ones to address challenges, review caseloads, and provide coaching.
Lead weekly team meetings to share updates, review cases, and encourage collaboration.
Meet in-person with staff regularly to maintain strong leadership presence.

Program Development & Quality Assurance

Establish benchmarks and metrics to track program performance.
Implement quality assurance protocols and standardized workflows.
Monitor staff performance and use data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.

Member Services Oversight

Ensure members are receiving in-person visits and high-quality care.
Monitor documentation and provide support for challenging cases.
Implement strategies to improve member engagement and satisfaction.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Serve as liaison between ECM program and hospitals, providers, and community organizations.
Collaborate with data and compliance teams to track outcomes and maintain regulatory standards.
Strengthen partnerships to improve care transitions and reduce hospital readmissions.

Budget & Resource Management

Develop and manage program budgets, allocate resources efficiently, and track expenditures.
Adjust staffing and resources based on member needs and program priorities.

Program Innovation & Growth

Identify opportunities to enhance program effectiveness.
Pilot new initiatives such as telehealth to expand access to care.
Stay current on best practices and integrate improvements.

Additional Examples

Lead operational huddles and bi-weekly case conferences.
Develop mentorship programs and regional trainings for staff.
Prepare quarterly performance reports and maintain stakeholder relationships.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Nursing, or related field.
5+ years in healthcare management, including 3+ years in care/case management.
2+ years managing Enhanced Care Management or intensive care management programs.

Knowledge & Skills

Understanding of care management principles and healthcare delivery systems.
Experience with Medicaid/Medicare programs and ECM program requirements.
Strong analytical skills and experience in data-driven program evaluation.

Personal Attributes

Strong leadership and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Commitment to person-centered care and health equity.

Working Conditions

Regular travel (65%) to county sites in California.
Occasional evening or weekend availability for program initiatives

Compensation

Pay: $80,000 - $85,000 annual salary

Requirements

Must reside within hiring county
Valid California Driver's License and active auto insurance meeting CA requirements
﻿Reliable personal vehicle for daily work use
﻿﻿Successful completion of background check (including MVR)
﻿﻿Must be able to travel up to 60-70% within the county to conduct in person visits
﻿﻿Must successfully complete a Testlify skills assessment
﻿﻿Must have a reliable working laptop for the first 21 days of employment (personal equipment stipend) until company issued laptop is received
﻿﻿Must have effective Time Management skills
﻿﻿Must have internet speed of - 300+ mbps download and 25+mbps upload
﻿﻿Must be proficient in technology, including documentation systems, case management platforms, and communication tools
Must be willing to work occasional evenings and weekends as needed

Benefits & Perks

160 Hours of Paid Time Off (PTO)
12 Paid Holidays per year, including your birthday and one floating holiday granted after 1 year of employment
4 Paid Volunteer Hours per Month to support causes you care about
Bereavement Leave, including Fur Baby Bereavement
90% Employer-paid Employee-Only Medical Benefits
FSA | Dependent Care Account
401(k) with Company Match
Monthly Stipend
Short-Term & Long-Term Disability | AD&D
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Employee Discounts via Great Work Perks and Perks at Work
Quarterly In-Person Events
Fully remote work within California
Opportunities for professional development and internal growth

new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Operations Analyst – ERP/MRP Operations
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Supply Chain Operations Analyst plays a critical role in executing the company’s transition from legacy supply chain and manufacturing planning processes to a fully integrated Material Requirements Planning (MRP) environment within Deltek Costpoint. Supporting the Strategic Operations Manager, this position converts strategic roadmaps into tactical execution across the value stream.

This role combines ERP functional expertise, data-driven decision making, and LEAN process optimization to standardize and stabilize MRP workflows across key programs. The analyst ensures data readiness, validates system outputs, develops standard work, and delivers training that enables planners, schedulers, and production teams to operate effectively in the enhanced ERP environment.

Key Responsibilities

Project Coordination & Execution
Execute assigned transition tasks within the MRP migration roadmap, ensuring smooth movement of identified programs from Compute Material Requirements (CMR) to Costpoint MRP.
Coordinate cross-functionally with the Program Management Office, Supply Chain, Operations Support teams to meet cut-over timelines without disrupting production.
Document project risks, mitigation actions, and system readiness assessments for review by the Strategic Operations Manager.
Support development of sustainment plans which maintain long-term stability in MRP performance.
Track milestones, report status, and escalate issues affecting schedule, data integrity, or operational readiness.
ERP Technical Implementation & Oversight
Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Deltek Costpoint MRP, ensuring the system is configured to optimize material flow and resource forecasting.
Facilitate system readiness reviews to ensure "MRP-ready" data integrity prior to job release.
Develop standardized work instructions and training materials that support consistent execution by planners and schedulers.
Conduct parallel testing between legacy and MRP outputs to validate accuracy.
Act as the primary point of contact for end-user troubleshooting during the transition phase.
LEAN Manufacturing & Process Improvement
Apply LEAN techniques to streamline planning workflows, eliminate waste, and optimize material and information flow.
Utilize Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and process mapping to identify bottlenecks in the current "as-is" state and design the future "to-be" state.
Drive a culture of continuous improvement, ensuring that the ERP utilization roadmap results in actual lead-time reductions and increased throughput.
Coordinate closely with Production Ops and support staff to align continuous improvement initiatives.
BI, Analytics & Performance Monitoring
Develop critical Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of the ERP system and stability of critical support processes.
Assist in the development of automated dashboards in PowerBI or similar BI platforms to provide real-time visibility into production health for the operations management team.
Translate complex ERP data into actionable insights to improve resource forecasting and procurement accuracy.

Required Qualifications

Required Education, Experience, & Skills

Bachelor’s Degree In a Relevant Field

Supply Chain Management
Industrial Engineering
Operations Management
Business Administration or similiar

5 to 8 years of professional experience in Supply Chain, Production Planning, or Operations

ERP Expertise: Experience implementing, supporting, or operating MRP modules within a large-scale ERP system; Deltek Costpoint experience strongly preferred.
LEAN Knowledge: Functional understanding of LEAN concepts including process mapping and value stream analysis.
Data Analytics: Analytical skill set with familiarity using BI tools such as PowerBI to visualize and interpret operational data.
Project Execution: Demonstrated ability to support organizational change initiatives, system transitions, or cross-functional process improvements.
Communication: Exceptional ability to effectively communicate technical requirements to end-users and provide clear status updates to management.
Collaboration: Experience working within cross-functional operational environments.

Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills

Experience in high-mix production environments supporting stringent government contract requirements.
LEAN Six Sigma Yellow/Green/Black Belt certification or training.
Advanced knowledge of Deltek Costpoint ERP.
Experience with Microsoft PowerBI as well as other dashboard and/or workflow tools.

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $67728 - $115138

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

About BAE Systems Intelligence & Security

BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference.

Intelligence & Security (I&S), based in McLean, Virginia, designs and delivers advanced defense, intelligence, and security solutions that support the important missions of our customers. Our pride and dedication shows in everything we do—from intelligence analysis, cyber operations and IT expertise to systems development, systems integration, and operations and maintenance services. Knowing that our work enables the U.S. military and government to recognize, manage and defeat threats inspires us to push ourselves and our technologies to new levels.

new_jobs.description:
DSV – Global Transport and Logistics

At DSV, our purpose is to keep customers’ supply chains flowing and enable the business of our customers by ensuring reliable and efficient transport and logistics services through storage and transport of goods by air, sea and road. Our vision is to create long-term, sustainable growth and value for our customers, employees, shareholders and society.

Close to 150,000 employees in over 90 countries work diligently to deliver great customer experiences and high-quality services.

As a global leader, our commitment to sustainable business practices is a central element of our overall business strategy.

Visit dsv.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook.

Location: USA - Mesa, W. Southern Ave

Division: Solutions

Job Posting Title: Customer Service Specialist, Operations Analyst

Time Type: Full Time

Position Summary

The Customer Service Operations Analyst is responsible for administering customer operational activities and business processes for assigned customers and programs within the Global One Source organization. This role serves as a key business partner between customers and internal stakeholders to ensure operational performance, customer commitments, and service expectations are achieved.

The Analyst evaluates customer requirements, operational performance, fulfillment challenges, and business risks to identify issues, determine appropriate corrective actions, and develop recommendations that improve customer outcomes and operational efficiency. The position exercises discretion and independent judgment in resolving customer issues, managing operational exceptions, evaluating performance trends, and implementing process improvements.

This role requires strong analytical capabilities, business acumen, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams to support customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and organizational growth.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Customer Operations Ownership

Manage operational activities for assigned customers, programs, and business processes.
Monitor customer operational performance to ensure service commitments, customer requirements, and business expectations are achieved.
Evaluate customer demand patterns, order activity, fulfillment performance, and operational trends to identify potential risks and opportunities.
Prioritize operational activities and recommend actions when competing customer demands or business constraints arise.
Serve as a primary point of contact for operational matters impacting assigned customers and programs.
Develop a comprehensive understanding of customer business requirements and operational objectives.

Business Issue Resolution and Decision Support

Evaluate operational exceptions, fulfillment challenges, customer concerns, and service disruptions to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions.
Investigate issues involving inventory availability, pricing discrepancies, order fulfillment performance, customer commitments, and supply chain constraints.
Develop recommendations that balance customer requirements with organizational objectives.
Exercise independent judgment when determining appropriate solutions and escalation pathways.
Partner with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to address significant customer or operational issues.
Identify operational risks and communicate recommended mitigation strategies to management.

Operational Analysis and Performance Management

Analyze operational performance metrics, customer trends, workload distribution, backlog performance, and service-level attainment.
Develop insights and recommendations that support operational decision-making and continuous improvement efforts.
Monitor key performance indicators and identify areas requiring corrective action.
Conduct root cause analysis on recurring service, operational, or customer issues.
Prepare operational summaries, performance analyses, and recommendations for leadership review.
Evaluate customer and operational data to identify trends impacting performance, profitability, and customer experience.

Process Improvement and Operational Excellence

Evaluate existing workflows and operational processes to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
Recommend and implement process enhancements designed to improve operational effectiveness, scalability, accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
Lead initiatives that reduce recurring issues, improve workflow consistency, and support sustainable growth.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process documentation, and operational best practices.
Assess the effectiveness of implemented solutions and recommend additional improvements where appropriate.
Support business initiatives related to customer retention, operational performance, and strategic growth objectives.

Cross-Functional Business Partnership

Collaborate with Customer Service leadership, Purchasing, Sourcing, Operations, Logistics, and Finance teams to achieve customer and business objectives.
Provide operational expertise and recommendations regarding customer requirements, service commitments, and business risks.
Support implementation of new customer programs, process changes, and operational initiatives.
Facilitate communication and alignment among stakeholders to ensure successful execution of customer requirements.
Promote knowledge sharing and collaboration across the Global One Source organization.

Order and Customer Operations Administration

Manage customer order activity and related operational processes to support fulfillment and customer service objectives.
Review customer transactions and operational activity for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established business requirements.
Evaluate order-related issues and determine appropriate actions to support customer commitments and operational objectives.
Maintain the integrity of customer, pricing, and operational data within company systems.
Identify trends impacting order flow, workload distribution, and operational efficiency and recommend appropriate actions.

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience

Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Finance, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum three (3) years of experience in customer operations, order management, supply chain, logistics, customer service, or a related business function.
Experience working in a cross-functional business environment and supporting customer-facing operations.

Skills, Knowledge And Abilities

Professional Competencies

Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion when evaluating customer and operational issues.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities.
Ability to identify business risks and develop practical solutions.
Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to influence outcomes through collaboration across multiple functional areas.
Strong business acumen and understanding of operational impacts on customer experience and organizational performance.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
High attention to detail, accuracy, and accountability.

Technical Competencies

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
Experience using ERP and business management systems.
Ability to analyze data and develop actionable business recommendations.
Experience utilizing reporting and performance metrics to support operational decisions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee rarely is exposed to fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.
